D1/EVENT.BIN:0.en:
Strange writing was inscribed on a crystal statue brought to a Tokyo laboratory from Aztec ruins.
In search of a lost civilization's knowledge, a computer in a Tokyo archaeology lab was put to work.
D1/EVENT.BIN:0.note: no pointer to this message (likely unused): narration - crystal statue from Aztec ruins brought to a Tokyo lab bore strange writing; a computer at a Tokyo archaeology lab was used to study it

D1/EVENT.BIN:10.en: They say it shines in rainbow colors under a certain wavelength of light!

D1/EVENT.BIN:101.en: From now on, you would do well to keep out of sight.

D1/EVENT.BIN:102.en: Father, why do you trust us?

D1/EVENT.BIN:103.en:
One of the people who fought beside you in the virtual space comes to this church.
Hearing their story, I knew you are not the people the papers describe.

D1/EVENT.BIN:104.en:
I'm trying to get back my brother. Demons took him.
The demons fight over and over to be reborn as stronger demons.
But none of that matters to me.|...If only Satoshi comes back...

D1/EVENT.BIN:105.en:
I understand wanting your brother back.
But the demons have come into this world and are attacking people.
Thinking only of your brother isn't enough, I'm afraid.
Someone must fight them in earnest and find out what is happening...

D1/EVENT.BIN:106.en: But people have armies. Fighting is their job.

D1/EVENT.BIN:107.en:
An army's tactics are made for humans fighting humans.
They won't work against demons.
I will help you. Let us fight together.

D1/EVENT.BIN:109.en: Dealing with demons has long been part of a pastor's work.

D1/EVENT.BIN:11.en: Wow! I'm going to take a closer look.

D1/EVENT.BIN:110.en:
Glad you came, Asuka!... I'm Maria Warwick.
Machine operator with the Marines - the US Marine Corps.

D1/EVENT.BIN:112.en:
Did it ever!
Sorry, Asuka, but I think I brought some demons back with me.
Everyone, could you lend me a hand...?

D1/EVENT.BIN:115.en:
Asuka! Something strange is going on.
The virtual space where we met changes its layout, and its demons, every time I go in!
As if the world itself were being reborn...

D1/EVENT.BIN:116.en:
Rebirth is spoken of in our Christian teachings too.
But I can hardly believe it truly happens.
Still, your brother may have been taken to one of the virtual spaces Maria described.
To find him, you should access the virtual space once more.

D1/EVENT.BIN:117.en:
However many virtual spaces the demons have made,
I'll go in as many times as it takes to find out where Satoshi was taken.

D1/EVENT.BIN:118.en:
The human soul, too, is reborn time and again.
No wonder, then, if the demons and their world are being reborn as well.
And your brother may have been taken to one of the virtual spaces Maria described.
To find him, you should access the virtual space once more.

D1/EVENT.BIN:12.en: Young man, do you know whose statue this is?

D1/EVENT.BIN:123.en:
Well, hey! It's you folks! Glad you came by.
How 'bout some tea?

D1/EVENT.BIN:124.en:
Sawaki told me all about you.
Damn demons. The nerve of 'em.

D1/EVENT.BIN:125.en:
He and I go way back.
It seems the demons are building netherworlds on the network, eating into the virtual spaces people made.

D1/EVENT.BIN:126.en:
The demons invaded the network I ran, too.
I got so mad I had Sawaki take me into the demons' virtual space.

D1/EVENT.BIN:127.en:
This guy's even got a doctorate in theoretical physics...
then outta nowhere he takes up archaeology. Real oddball.

D1/EVENT.BIN:128.en:
Enough about me, Pops.
Oh, Asuka, there's something I'd like to talk over with you.
Come by my lab at T University later. I'll go ahead and wait for you. I'm counting on you.

D1/EVENT.BIN:129.en:
Oh, right. Thompson left this behind in the lab.
It might help you, so I'll leave it with you. See you!

D1/EVENT.BIN:13.en: No. It was only just discovered, wasn't it?

D1/EVENT.BIN:130.en:
Looks like Sawaki's taken a shine to you.
He ain't the type to ask people for favors like that.

D1/EVENT.BIN:131.en:
Now that you mention it... Asuka, was it?
As a kid, he got picked on and made to cry all the time.
And my little rascal here used to stick up for him and knock those bullies flat.

D1/EVENT.BIN:132.en:
Pop, quit blabbing. It's embarrassing.
That guy really is a super genius, you know.
In high school he solved a math proof even university professors couldn't. Blew the teachers away.

D1/EVENT.BIN:134.en: Asuka, you hear Sawaki out, will ya?

D1/EVENT.BIN:136.en:
Sawaki, you're like a super genius, right?
And you're the one who took the sysop and them into the demons' virtual space, right?
We're looking for a virtual space called Caina.
They say Satoshi's in there.

D1/EVENT.BIN:137.en:
I'm no genius.
And when it comes to networks, the sysop knows far more than I do.

D1/EVENT.BIN:138.en: What did you want to talk to me about?

D1/EVENT.BIN:139.en:
Well, I've been looking into this whole affair in my own way.
It seems the crystal statue found in the Aztec ruins is where it all began,
but I can't check the data, because Professor Ando won't release it...

D1/EVENT.BIN:14.en:
Yes... But I know.
I know that this is a statue of a demon called Moloch.

D1/EVENT.BIN:140.en:
That's not right.
People are being attacked by demons, and he won't show the data that started it?

D1/EVENT.BIN:141.en:
Some scholars cling to their power.
Anyway, what I wanted to ask you about is Muhammad there...

D1/EVENT.BIN:143.en: Have you found out something about him?

D1/EVENT.BIN:144.en: I'm not sure yet... Let me talk with him a little.

D1/EVENT.BIN:146.en: Where you were born, memories from your childhood...

D1/EVENT.BIN:148.en: Do you know how to work out the Pythagorean theorem?

D1/EVENT.BIN:152.en: Amazing! Muhammad, you're actually a brain!

D1/EVENT.BIN:153.en: Where did you learn all that?

D1/EVENT.BIN:155.en:
......I see...... ...Perhaps...
Asuka, would you leave him with me? I'd like to learn more about what he knows.

D1/EVENT.BIN:158.en:
......Understood.
Perhaps you can understand me... Is that all right, Asuka?

D1/EVENT.BIN:159.en:
Muhammad, you can come back whenever you like.
Also, I hear there's a new system disk for the Remix Station.
I should have it soon, so I'll get one ready for you too.
And about the virtual space called Caina, go back to Shibuya and ask the sysop.
With his company's network, I think you'll find a way into Caina.

D1/EVENT.BIN:16.en: My name is Moloch. I am he who offers sacrifice to the King.

D1/EVENT.BIN:160.en: Well, actually, I'm just headin' out. I'll be right back, so wait for me, okay?

D1/EVENT.BIN:162.en:
Aw, it's about those demons we gave a beatin' together...
my idiot son, the network sysop, got himself fired.
They said he wrecked the company network on his own.
So that numbskull goes, "What's wrong with fightin' demons?"
and storms off to the company to give 'em hell, and he ain't come back since.
So I'm goin' over to his company to see what's what.

D1/EVENT.BIN:165.en:
Asuka! Fired for fighting demons? That smells fishy.
Let's go too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:166.en:
Yeah! And Sawaki said the sysop would know about Caina,
the network city where Satoshi was taken!

D1/EVENT.BIN:167.en:
Yeah? Sorry for the trouble...
That idiot son of mine's always a handful.

D1/EVENT.BIN:168.en:
Hey!! Open up, I said!!
You spineless blockhead! Open up or I'll bust this thing down!! ...Huff, huff...

D1/EVENT.BIN:17.en: Asuka, cheer up... I'm sure Satoshi will come back.

D1/EVENT.BIN:170.en: What...!? What is this...!! ...Everyone, over here!

D1/EVENT.BIN:171.en: They're building netherworlds in the virtual spaces on the network.

D1/EVENT.BIN:172.en:
One of these must be Caina!
...Sysop! Can you tell which one is Caina?

D1/EVENT.BIN:173.en:
Most of these virtual spaces look unfinished.
Accessing an unfinished virtual space is dangerous.
If you access an incomplete field, it will destroy your nervous system.

D1/EVENT.BIN:174.en: Then I'll go anyway...! To get Satoshi back...

D1/EVENT.BIN:175.en:
Even now, the demons
are still building their netherworlds in the virtual spaces.

D1/EVENT.BIN:176.en:
That's it! The president of this company
should know the key code that opens the whole network.
...But he hasn't shown up at work for a while.
Nobody's seen him since he left, saying he was going somewhere with a foreigner named Thompson.

D1/EVENT.BIN:177.en:
Asuka, why don't we go back to Tokyo?
If we ask Sawaki, he might know where Thompson would go.

D1/EVENT.BIN:178.en: True. Thompson apparently showed up at T University a lot.

D1/EVENT.BIN:179.en:
Hey, you finally made it. I've been waiting for you.
Thanks to Muhammad, I was able to decode the demon data.

D1/EVENT.BIN:181.en:
Well, the answer is both yes and no...
Demons themselves are life-forms not so different from humans...
Of course, there's plenty they can do that humans can't, like their special powers...

D1/EVENT.BIN:182.en: The demons said that dying in battle lets them be reborn into a new life...

D1/EVENT.BIN:183.en:
Yes, that's the part I mean.
A single demon has no such mechanism inside it.
But it seems they remember what came before their rebirth...

D1/EVENT.BIN:184.en: They remember the lives they've lived...???

D1/EVENT.BIN:185.en:
Yes. Memories we humans may have lost,
memories of past lives, seem to live on in them.

D1/EVENT.BIN:186.en: Are you saying humans are reborn too?

D1/EVENT.BIN:187.en:
Maybe we just don't remember!
If so, we can't rule out the conclusion that rebirth is possible, can we?

D1/EVENT.BIN:188.en:
Maybe rebirth is possible.
But right now, finding my brother comes first.
The network company's president, who seems to be with Thompson, knows the key code to the virtual spaces.
I came because I thought you might know where he'd be.

D1/EVENT.BIN:189.en:
I heard Thompson left Tokyo for a hospital in Kamakura.
An assistant overheard Professor Ando talking about it earlier.
Oh, and I got the new Remix system disk! Give it a try.

D1/EVENT.BIN:19.en: Asuka! Someone's running wild in Yoyogi Park!

D1/EVENT.BIN:192.en: Inside the general hospital stood the same equipment as the Remix Station in Neo Coast.

D1/EVENT.BIN:194.en:
You got fired, didn't ya?
No need to go callin' a man like that "president."

D1/EVENT.BIN:195.en:
Easy for you to say! I can't just switch overnight!
I'm not a loose cannon like you, Pop!

D1/EVENT.BIN:196.en:
Hah! Listen to the mouth on him!
They fired you and nearly got you killed!

D1/EVENT.BIN:197.en:
Quit arguing about nothing.
...Hey, Mr. Sysop. Did you ask the president about the network?

D1/EVENT.BIN:198.en:
Yeah. According to him,
Professor Ando from T University and some government official, an old student of his, asked him for it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:199.en:
Professor Ando!?
Isn't that the archaeology professor Sawaki mentioned?

D1/EVENT.BIN:2.en: Yeah. First time I've ever tried decoding ancient writing!

D1/EVENT.BIN:20.en:
People who fled the park say demons attacked them.
I heard some died on the way to the hospital.

D1/EVENT.BIN:200.en: The man who dug up that demon's crystal statue...

D1/EVENT.BIN:201.en:
Professor Ando and that official asked to use the network,
saying it was for a national project already underway.

D1/EVENT.BIN:202.en: Sounds like Japan's politicians and big business are helping the demons.

D1/EVENT.BIN:203.en:
To bureaucrats, money and power are all that ever matter!
They won't lose much sleep if we get eaten alive by demons.

D1/EVENT.BIN:205.en:
To think humans would toy with the body of the great Lilim...
The humiliation you dealt me is a crime that shall never be forgiven. I will have my revenge.

D1/EVENT.BIN:208.en: Lilim! I've found you at last!

D1/EVENT.BIN:209.en:
Azazel!! Why are you with these humans?
You never even came to rescue me... What is the meaning of this??

D1/EVENT.BIN:211.en:
Why are men always like this?
One look at a sexy woman and they all start drooling...
But Lilim really is sexy. No wonder Azazel doesn't want to be reborn.

D1/EVENT.BIN:212.en:
Thompson said he was collecting demon genes.
He took my bodily fluids too. On my name as a demon, I will repay him.
Until then, I don't mind traveling with you.
But right now I need rest. I'll be borrowing Azazel for a while.

D1/EVENT.BIN:213.en: Ah... sorry!! I'll be right back...

D1/EVENT.BIN:214.en:
Asuka, you saw that!
Get mixed up with a wicked woman like her and she'll jerk you around however she likes.

D1/EVENT.BIN:216.en: Asuka, we have to find the captive president...

D1/EVENT.BIN:217.en: He should know how to access Caina.

D1/EVENT.BIN:218.en:
He's the one lettin' the demons use the network.
This is exactly why you can't trust rich folks.

D1/EVENT.BIN:219.en: If we find the president, I bet we'll find out where Satoshi is too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:22.en:
Let's go see...
Wherever the demons are, Satoshi has to be there too.
We might be able to get him back!

D1/EVENT.BIN:220.en: I figured out how to access Caina! Now we can get in anytime.

D1/EVENT.BIN:222.en:
I am Minamoto no Yoritomo! Are you not Yoshitsune!?
You dare show your face so brazenly after betraying your own brother...!

D1/EVENT.BIN:223.en: What are you babbling about! Minamoto no Yoshitsune can't still be alive!

D1/EVENT.BIN:224.en:
...What are you talking about?
...Ugh......... What's happening to me!?

D1/EVENT.BIN:227.en:
Benkei...?? What are you talking about!
Are you losing it too? We already locked that patient back in his room...

D1/EVENT.BIN:229.en:
Keita, don't be so hard on Asuka!
So much has happened, it'd be no wonder if we all lost our minds...

D1/EVENT.BIN:23.en: What are you waiting for? Let's get to Yoyogi Park!

D1/EVENT.BIN:230.en:
...Reika... thanks... I'm fine now...
Keita, sorry about that!

D1/EVENT.BIN:231.en: We have to go to the virtual space where Satoshi is.

D1/EVENT.BIN:232.en:
Yeah, the virtual space Moloch called Caina.
This time we save Satoshi for sure.

D1/EVENT.BIN:237.en: This time I'm bringing him back! ...Let's go!!

D1/EVENT.BIN:24.en: Asuka, let's hurry! I'm worried about Satoshi.

D1/EVENT.BIN:240.en: You're late, Big Brother. Why didn't you come sooner?

D1/EVENT.BIN:242.en:
It's too late...
Moloch has offered up my soul to the great being that is to come...
What you see now is just an empty shell without a soul.

D1/EVENT.BIN:243.en:
Come back, Satoshi!
I'll take care of everything else! If you've lost your soul, we'll just get it back.
Don't give up!

D1/EVENT.BIN:244.en:
Heh heh heh...
To rescue a brother in the netherworld of Cain, who slew his own brother... What a curious turn of fate.
But Satoshi I cannot return. The time of the covenant with my great master draws near.

D1/EVENT.BIN:245.en: Sawaki said Thompson's at T University, right?

D1/EVENT.BIN:246.en:
Yeah...
But wouldn't it be better to find Sawaki first...?

D1/EVENT.BIN:247.en:
Satoshi got taken to Duat.
Catchin' Thompson and that Professor Ando and makin' 'em talk about the demons might be the shortcut,
but goin' where Sawaki is for fresh info could help too, huh?

D1/EVENT.BIN:249.en:
We were simply ordered by the government
to study the first intelligent life-form humanity has ever encountered.
You have no grounds to blame us.

D1/EVENT.BIN:25.en:
Asuka, remember the man we met in Yoyogi Park?
He saw the DIS and mentioned a guy named Thompson.

D1/EVENT.BIN:250.en:
Even if people are eaten alive and cities destroyed because of it,
you're saying you did nothing wrong?

D1/EVENT.BIN:251.en:
I only did as I was ordered.
Besides, scholars do research. Judging the results is the job of the government that gave the orders.

D1/EVENT.BIN:252.en: What did the government tell you to do?

D1/EVENT.BIN:253.en:
At first, it was to decipher the writing on the crystal statue found in the Aztec ruins
with the supercomputer at this university.
We built 3D data of the statue, restored its placement in the ruins,
and decoded the cipher, which was laid out in three dimensions...... The result was...... unbelievable.

D1/EVENT.BIN:254.en:
The symbols carved into the crystal statue were a demon regeneration program.
Once the decoding program started, it automatically assembled a program that generates demons,
which then launched and began producing biological data.
It even held information at the genetic level.
Demon data was being born, by itself, inside the computer.
And at the same time, it built the virtual spaces to place the demons in.

D1/EVENT.BIN:255.en:
And it moved onto the network?
So it wouldn't matter if the supercomputer were destroyed...

D1/EVENT.BIN:256.en:
Yes. It is a truly meticulous program.
Merely trying to analyze the data sets everything in motion. And no one can stop it...
It would take an intelligence able to foresee every move the human mind could make.

D1/EVENT.BIN:257.en:
So we're the organ grinder's monkey, running around for a treat!
Us humans...

D1/EVENT.BIN:258.en:
In any case, demon data remained in the computer.
As did a message to humanity... But from there on, the government took charge.

D1/EVENT.BIN:259.en:
Then Thompson, possessed by a demon, showed up and used the genetic information
to start creating new demons.

D1/EVENT.BIN:26.en:
Yeah, I remember.
He said this Thompson has a DIS too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:260.en:
Falling deeper and deeper into their trap...
never knowing the demons were just buying time...

D1/EVENT.BIN:262.en: Asuka, come here a moment... Sawaki's asking for you.

D1/EVENT.BIN:27.en: That's right. A man was talking to Satoshi at the museum, remember?

D1/EVENT.BIN:273.en:
She still does the fusions we ask for...
but she's been running the Remix on her own, creating demons.
Almost as if she means to start a war.

D1/EVENT.BIN:274.en:
Asuka, I can't say if it's tied to Saturday,
but the phase of the network into the virtual spaces has gone unstable, as if someone's interfering.
Better hold off on accessing it until the virtual spaces settle down.
I'd say we either wait here a while longer or look into Saturday.

D1/EVENT.BIN:275.en:
Now, Aeacus...
The time has come to entrust the final choice to the great will.

D1/EVENT.BIN:276.en:
It seems the final hour has come.
Because of this wounded soul,
my duty as queen of this Demon World, aiding the demons' rebirth, is at its end as well.

D1/EVENT.BIN:278.en: Lady Athena. It has been a long time.

D1/EVENT.BIN:279.en:
......Humans are foolish.
I have no intention of obeying human demands any longer.

D1/EVENT.BIN:28.en: Something about a lab in Neo Coast City in Ariake...

D1/EVENT.BIN:280.en:
Asuka......
I got into a new network city, and there's someone in it who looks like your brother.
I'll put it on the monitor.

D1/EVENT.BIN:282.en:
When I looked a moment ago, he was standing on top of that altar.
He may have gone down the back.

D1/EVENT.BIN:285.en: What is it, Maria? What's about to happen?

D1/EVENT.BIN:287.en:
O Tezcatlipoca, god who breathes fire!
Lover of darkness and evil, who wages the eternal war!
In your name, receive the blood of the human sacrifice offered here, and fulfill the words of the Covenant!
Until those words are fulfilled, I shall offer upon this altar blood of sacrifice that never ceases.

D1/EVENT.BIN:29.en: ...Let's go to Neo Coast City in Ariake.

D1/EVENT.BIN:290.en: Maria, get me into this virtual space!

D1/EVENT.BIN:291.en:
Asuka, this virtual space's phase is unstable - I can't access it!
Its position keeps shifting, like it's drifting across the network...

D1/EVENT.BIN:292.en:
If we don't stop Satoshi right now,
the kids the demons kidnapped will be sacrificed...

D1/EVENT.BIN:294.en:
This is your last chance! Do as I say!
Then I'll give you a share of the human world too!

D1/EVENT.BIN:295.en:
Satoshi! How many times do I have to tell you!
If you keep doing this, everyone will be heartbroken...
Let's get out of this world of demons and go home...

D1/EVENT.BIN:297.en: Asuka, we have to stop Satoshi.

D1/EVENT.BIN:298.en:
Yeah... Maria!
Isn't there some way to pin down that virtual space's phase?

D1/EVENT.BIN:299.en: The whole network city is under some kind of interference.

D1/EVENT.BIN:3.en:
Well, the computer does the rest. We'll have results in two or three days.
Assuming these symbols actually mean anything, that is.

D1/EVENT.BIN:302.en: ...A human reclaiming the memory of rebirth...

D1/EVENT.BIN:305.en:
Those are names of mighty sorcerers from the old legends of my people...
Asuka, how do you know those names?

D1/EVENT.BIN:306.en:
Those are names of sorcerers from old Native American legends...
Asuka, how do you know those names?

D1/EVENT.BIN:308.en:
Asuka, the phase is still fluctuating.
I can't say what'll happen, but do you want to try accessing the network city?

D1/EVENT.BIN:309.en:
I can't believe Satoshi would do something like that on his own.
Moloch must be scaring him into it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:31.en: Yeah... and it's huge. You could hold a track meet in here.

D1/EVENT.BIN:310.en:
But to stop Satoshi, we gotta get into the network.
Sounds kinda dicey, but aw, once we're in there, we'll manage somehow, won't we?

D1/EVENT.BIN:311.en:
Force our way into the network...?
Or look into Saturday first.

D1/EVENT.BIN:312.en:
......Humans are foolish.
I have no intention of obeying human demands any longer.
If you insist on bending me to your will, there is no way but to defeat me in battle.

D1/EVENT.BIN:314.en: It's called an android! Pop, you're so behind the times...

D1/EVENT.BIN:315.en: But he was one of us!

D1/EVENT.BIN:316.en:
Right. He was more human than most humans.
We've got to do something for him.

D1/EVENT.BIN:317.en: Do something...?? Can anything be done??

D1/EVENT.BIN:318.en:
I can't say right now...
but if we can find parts that can regenerate his nerves, we might be able to bring him back.

D1/EVENT.BIN:319.en: Looks like the Remix Station business is settled, more or less.

D1/EVENT.BIN:32.en:
So you could... Hm? What's that...?
...A person! Someone's collapsed over there!

D1/EVENT.BIN:320.en:
The network fluctuations seem to be dying down as well.
If we wait a little longer, we should be able to get in.

D1/EVENT.BIN:321.en:
If we've got time, let's head to Ikebukuro.
I'm not letting them sacrifice any more kids!

D1/EVENT.BIN:322.en:
I am Athena, queen of the Demon World...
...She who has lived through the hour of betrayal... ...whose task is to watch life's changes through a wounded soul.

D1/EVENT.BIN:323.en:
No!! The virtual space's phase is slipping!
We might not be able to get in. ...Everyone, be careful...

D1/EVENT.BIN:324.en: Is there something you want from us?

D1/EVENT.BIN:325.en:
...Netherworld of the traitors... Welcome to Antenora...
The gate to a hell where unbearable suffering goes on forever as proof of existence.....

D1/EVENT.BIN:328.en:
Ha ha ha ha...! Big Brother, what did you come for?
All the way out here.....

D1/EVENT.BIN:329.en:
Satoshi! What are you saying!
We came to rescue you...

D1/EVENT.BIN:33.en: Is he dead? Maybe the demons outside got him.

D1/EVENT.BIN:333.en:
The pain... the pain... how many times I called for help...!
My body torn apart, my heart ripped to shreds, my soul wrung out of me...
hearing them jeer, how I waited for you all to come save me.....

D1/EVENT.BIN:335.en:
And look at me now!... ......Look at me!!
While you were busy with your demons, the demons dressed me in these robes and made me their king.

D1/EVENT.BIN:337.en:
It's all right now, Big Brother!
In this hell I've gained eternal life as king of the demons.
So stop chasing after me.
And as punishment for betraying me, you can stay chained in the netherworld of Antenora forever.
...Moloch!!......

D1/EVENT.BIN:339.en:
I'm tired. Dispose of these humans by the laws of hell.
I'm taking Joker back to the temple.

D1/EVENT.BIN:340.en:
As you command.
To make them atone for betraying their King, there could be no place more fitting than the netherworld of Antenora.

D1/EVENT.BIN:341.en:
...Satoshi!! ...Wake up! And come back!
No matter what they did to you, your soul is still inside you!
As my brother, as a human being, I believe you held on to your soul!

D1/EVENT.BIN:342.en:
Ha ha ha... Give it a rest, Big Brother!
You're the one who needs to wake up.
You hardly see a human soul anymore, even up in the world above...

D1/EVENT.BIN:343.en:
Well then, shall we begin?
Antenora's banquet of welcome for the brother who betrayed his brother, and his friends!

D1/EVENT.BIN:344.en: Someone saw a demon that took children flying toward Mt. Fuji.

D1/EVENT.BIN:346.en:
Heh heh heh...... So you followed me!
Human souls tangling themselves in our place of rebirth...
It seems the ancient prophecy has begun to awaken.

D1/EVENT.BIN:348.en:
How foolish humans are.
Forcibly making demons who cannot be reborn, using only their power to bend this world to their will...
Asuka, enemy though you are, you and your friends alone seem free of such folly.

D1/EVENT.BIN:349.en: Wasn't all of this the demons' scheme to begin with?

D1/EVENT.BIN:350.en:
It was not.
The powerful of this country came seeking our strength.
We used their greed to buy time, but the power of this world holds no appeal for us.

D1/EVENT.BIN:351.en: Then what do the demons want?

D1/EVENT.BIN:352.en:
We want nothing.
We only carry the lives we were given into the next world, as we are guided...

D1/EVENT.BIN:353.en: Then why take my brother? And Reika too...

D1/EVENT.BIN:354.en:
Even I have not been told.
Your brother has begun to act as one of our demon kings.
The human world will likely be ruled by him from now on.
The rumor is that it is to aid our rebirth...

D1/EVENT.BIN:355.en: Didn't you say demons have no use for power in the human world?

D1/EVENT.BIN:356.en:
Yes. It makes no sense to me either.
Lord Aeacus may know the true reason.

D1/EVENT.BIN:357.en: And where is this demon Aeacus?

D1/EVENT.BIN:358.en:
A world beyond time and space... ...our world...
Long ago, humans called it the Demon World.

D1/EVENT.BIN:360.en:
Asuka, you will soon be guided there...
And in the Demon World, you will meet Lord Aeacus.

D1/EVENT.BIN:362.en:
The same question again...
It is human arrogance to think everything can be understood.
Asuka, simply let yourself be guided... ...that is all you need.

D1/EVENT.BIN:363.en:
Now, I must go......
If you wish to end this, you must open the door to the Demon World and hear the words of the Covenant.

D1/EVENT.BIN:366.en: Asuka, you're going into the shrine where the demons appeared?

D1/EVENT.BIN:367.en: ...Yeah. We might find out where Satoshi is.

D1/EVENT.BIN:369.en:
You bet! I'm Tokyo born and bred!
Folks in trouble, and I'm gonna look the other way? Not a chance!

D1/EVENT.BIN:37.en: Oh, he's alive! Hey, pull yourself together!

D1/EVENT.BIN:370.en:
Aeacus of the Demon World sent her back. He said it isn't her time to be reborn yet...
But she hasn't recovered enough to walk on her own.

D1/EVENT.BIN:371.en:
Poor thing...
Let's let her rest a while.

D1/EVENT.BIN:372.en:
Asuka, while you were in the Demon World, demons started showing up all over.
Chigasaki, Yokohama... and I hear new virtual spaces have appeared too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:373.en: You appear in my netherworld and meddle needlessly in the law of demon rebirth. To what end?

D1/EVENT.BIN:374.en:
To open the door to the Demon World and demand from Aeacus
the meaning of the Covenant said to have been sworn before time began...

D1/EVENT.BIN:375.en:
You would go to the Demon World...?
A bold thought for a mere human.
Do you think a human can grasp the secret of rebirth that is hidden even from us?

D1/EVENT.BIN:376.en: Because of that Covenant, my brother is trying to become a demon king.

D1/EVENT.BIN:377.en:
Humans have souls too.
Fighting can't be the only way to live in this world.

D1/EVENT.BIN:378.en:
I see. For us demonkind, fighting is the way to live.
To be reborn again and again, fight on, and gain ever greater power... that is what our lives were given for.
Very well. If you wish to go to the Demon World, go.

D1/EVENT.BIN:379.en:
Wait! Asuka!! ......
Come back! ...No matter what!

D1/EVENT.BIN:384.en: It has been a long time.

D1/EVENT.BIN:385.en: A long time...??? We've never met...

D1/EVENT.BIN:386.en: Of course not. Not in this world, at least...

D1/EVENT.BIN:387.en:
Forgive me, but I don't understand what you mean.
Do you know me??

D1/EVENT.BIN:388.en:
Of course, my lord.
Before the endless flow of time began,
you swore the words of the Covenant here in the Demon World. Keeping to them, I have awaited you.

D1/EVENT.BIN:389.en:
Wait!
I haven't come back. Aren't you mistaking me for someone else?

D1/EVENT.BIN:390.en: Then who do you claim to be?

D1/EVENT.BIN:392.en: And what has this Asuka Miroku come to the Demon World for?

D1/EVENT.BIN:393.en: To take back my brother, whom the demons carried off.

D1/EVENT.BIN:394.en:
What is it, Aeacus??
What is this covenant the demons talk about?
Why was Satoshi taken? What do you mean to make him do as king of the demons!?

D1/EVENT.BIN:395.en:
Only lives that have been guided may set foot in the Demon World.
And yet, how did one with no such right come this far?

D1/EVENT.BIN:396.en:
Since before I came to this Demon World, chosen by time,
no one asking such questions has ever been guided here.

D1/EVENT.BIN:397.en:
I didn't come to the Demon World because I wanted to!
The demons that crossed time into my world are dragging it into slaughter and destruction.
And the one guiding those demons is... Aeacus!! You, isn't it!?

D1/EVENT.BIN:398.en:
As ruler of the Demon World, guiding the demons is indeed my duty,
but those demons were guided into the human world because humans wished it!

D1/EVENT.BIN:399.en:
Wrong! You demons came into the human world
following that ancient covenant you keep talking about!
Who was it sworn with, and what does it say? You know! ...And you're going to tell me!

D1/EVENT.BIN:4.en: Anyway, our part's done. ...Let's head home...

D1/EVENT.BIN:40.en:
Who...? ...Mu... ham... mad...
Demons... attacked... After that... I cannot remember.

D1/EVENT.BIN:400.en:
I have nothing to tell you about rebirth!
To us demons, the affairs of this world exist only for the sake of rebirth.
You who would set foot even in the Demon World - why can you not understand that!

D1/EVENT.BIN:401.en:
Where do you come from, and where would you be reborn?
What do you want from humans?

D1/EVENT.BIN:402.en:
Why are you so sure rebirth was given only to demons?
Heh heh heh... Very well, Asuka Miroku!
How life has been handed down, how you have fought again and again...
Go and see it with your own eyes!

D1/EVENT.BIN:403.en: Guided One, could you accept the course of your rebirths?

D1/EVENT.BIN:404.en:
Humans, demons, and even gods
are reborn again and again in a closed world until the final hour...
Fated, yet not fated: even endless life comes to the final hour.
...And creation and destruction repeat.
What lies hidden in your still-sleeping mind, you will know when that hour comes......

D1/EVENT.BIN:405.en:
........
This girl tried to bend her own rebirth for your sake, and was trapped between dimensions.
Return together, and live out your lives.

D1/EVENT.BIN:408.en:
Guided One...
Should you set foot in the Demon World again, every question you wished answered shall be made clear.

D1/EVENT.BIN:41.en: All right, don't worry. We'll get you out of here.

D1/EVENT.BIN:410.en: Sakurako... don't worry. Asuka will come back, I know it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:413.en: Asuka, Satoshi and his demons have sealed off Tokyo.

D1/EVENT.BIN:415.en:
Satoshi has gone mad!
He's built a sacrificial altar in the heart of the city and keeps killing children, one after another.

D1/EVENT.BIN:416.en: They're kidnapping children from all over the world and offering them to Satoshi as sacrifices.

D1/EVENT.BIN:417.en:
Satoshi says that by sacrificing the children
he'll be reborn as the Demon God.
We have no idea what it means...

D1/EVENT.BIN:419.en:
Oh......
Never mind that, we have to stop Satoshi. How do we get back to Tokyo?

D1/EVENT.BIN:42.en:
Looks like there's nobody here but him.
What was going on in this place, anyway?

D1/EVENT.BIN:420.en:
No good, there's no getting back to Tokyo.
All transit's shut down, and the roads are blockaded by demons.
If we fight our way through, we have to expect heavy losses.
The demon army wiped out the Ground Self-Defense Force units massed north of Mt. Fuji.

D1/EVENT.BIN:421.en:
Whatever it costs, I'll stop Satoshi!
...If I have to... ...I'll take him down myself...

D1/EVENT.BIN:422.en: Thank you. The demons came to take this child.

D1/EVENT.BIN:423.en:
If you hadn't come, they'd have killed us too.
This child's mother was killed by the demons.

D1/EVENT.BIN:426.en:
Sakurako, what's wrong?
Nobody's talking to you!

D1/EVENT.BIN:427.en:
Someone is talking to me.
Right into my mind...

D1/EVENT.BIN:428.en: ......It's this baby!! ...Go on, try talking to it!

D1/EVENT.BIN:43.en:
When we came into this room,
I found some interesting data on the console by the wall.
There's a network this place accessed almost every day.

D1/EVENT.BIN:430.en:
Human woman... can you hear my voice?
...The voice of my soul... ...dwelling in this life... ...just born...

D1/EVENT.BIN:432.en:
I am the soul of the great angel Lucifer,
permitted to descend to this earth once more to meet the final hour.

D1/EVENT.BIN:435.note: developer dummy (ダミー), no pointer; shrunk by insert_event DUMMIES

D1/EVENT.BIN:436.note: developer dummy (ダミー), no pointer; shrunk by insert_event DUMMIES

D1/EVENT.BIN:437.en:
You who hear the voice of souls...
Take me with you, and prepare for the final battle.

D1/EVENT.BIN:439.en:
Asuka, we all talked it over - what we should do from here.
Everyone knows you mean to go to Tokyo to stop your brother.
And that you've kept quiet because it's hard to tell us.

D1/EVENT.BIN:440.en:
We were born in different places and raised in different worlds.
But we have fought the demons side by side and come this far together.

D1/EVENT.BIN:441.en:
We all feel the same.
In the end, we didn't even need to talk. And we decided...
...we'd never let you go alone...

D1/EVENT.BIN:442.en:
Let's go, Asuka!
However strong the demons make their defenses, as long as we stick together,
we'll make it to the sacrificial altar where Satoshi is. No doubt about it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:443.en: Everyone's waiting! For you to give the word to move out!

D1/EVENT.BIN:444.en:
...Thank you...
...And please tell everyone how I feel.

D1/EVENT.BIN:447.en: Thank you... ...It is all thanks to everyone.

D1/EVENT.BIN:448.en:
We only did what was right.
As comrades who fought together... and as friends.

D1/EVENT.BIN:45.en:
They were certainly using the network lines for something.
In any case, there's no point staying here for now.
Come, Muhammad, on your feet. Asuka! Let's head outside.

D1/EVENT.BIN:451.en: What are you doing! ......Kill them! Kill them!

D1/EVENT.BIN:453.note: developer dummy (ダミー), no pointer; shrunk by insert_event DUMMIES

D1/EVENT.BIN:454.note: developer dummy (ダミー), no pointer; shrunk by insert_event DUMMIES

D1/EVENT.BIN:455.en: So... you... did... it... Big... Bro... ther!

D1/EVENT.BIN:457.en:
...The time of my rebirth has come...
...The words of the Covenant are fulfilled... ...only the final hour remains...

D1/EVENT.BIN:458.en:
Guided One... ...why do you grieve?
Now, as the final hour begins,
as the closed door of this world opens and the birth of a new world draws near......

D1/EVENT.BIN:459.en:
A new world... ...I don't need one!
I was born in this world, I live in this world, and I'll die in this world!

D1/EVENT.BIN:46.en: Muhammad... take it easy. Did you remember something?

D1/EVENT.BIN:460.en: Do you cling to this world so?

D1/EVENT.BIN:461.en:
It's not clinging!...
I... I love this world! Its light, its wind, its sea, its sky... the lives living in it......

D1/EVENT.BIN:462.en: I took it with my own hands! The life of my only brother...

D1/EVENT.BIN:463.en: When a new world is born, new life is born as well.

D1/EVENT.BIN:464.en:
Maybe so... but it won't be this world.
And it won't change the fact that I killed my brother.

D1/EVENT.BIN:465.en:
He chose his rebirth himself.
He wished to be reborn as the Demon God...
Either you or Satoshi was to be reborn as the Demon God.
Satoshi knew, and tried to become the Demon God himself...

D1/EVENT.BIN:466.en:
Do you still not understand?
He offered sacrifices to begin his rebirth as king of the demons, and earn the right to become the Demon God.

D1/EVENT.BIN:467.en: I have no wish to become any Demon God!!

D1/EVENT.BIN:468.en:
The Demon God is reborn into the final age!
It is not something one chooses to become!

D1/EVENT.BIN:469.en:
Then leave me alone!
All I care about is living in this world.

D1/EVENT.BIN:47.en: Keita, let's leave him be for a while.

D1/EVENT.BIN:470.en:
And after you die, be reborn?
Asuka, either way, you cannot escape your fate.
Even so, will you chase this world's comforts like other humans?

D1/EVENT.BIN:471.en:
Very well, Asuka! Choose your own path.
Will you remain in this world and accept its final hour?
Or decide this world's fate by your own will...
Until the moon sinks below the horizon, I shall hold open a door to the Demon World atop that altar.
The door to the world's final hour!!

D1/EVENT.BIN:472.en:
Asuka, the demons have gone away somewhere.
The world's at peace again, isn't it?

D1/EVENT.BIN:473.en:
......Asuka, don't think about Satoshi anymore...!
In a way, that boy gave himself up for all of us.

D1/EVENT.BIN:475.en:
Go to the Demon World?|Yes
No

D1/EVENT.BIN:478.en:
Yeah. Whatever life I'm reborn into next,
if we protected this world, I've got no regrets about this one.

D1/EVENT.BIN:479.en:
But......
I can't believe it's all just going to end like this. Was this really for the best??

D1/EVENT.BIN:48.en:
I agree with Sakurako.
More to the point, why don't we visit that network company in Shinjuku?

D1/EVENT.BIN:480.en:
Hey, hey, don't jinx it... Look, the sun's com... ...in'...
Huh?? What... is that...?

D1/EVENT.BIN:481.en:
Asuka Miroku... or rather... ...life that was called by that name...
...Lend your ear to my words...

D1/EVENT.BIN:483.en: Life that exists in every time and space... ...life without a name...

D1/EVENT.BIN:485.en: Existence without meaning... ...life apart from words and thought

D1/EVENT.BIN:486.en:
Humans...
from birth until death, live with their lives shut inside illusion.
Human life...
is led astray by voices, lost in light, and ends imprisoned in flesh.

D1/EVENT.BIN:487.en:
Asuka, break through the door of illusion and awaken to life's true form!
The world has no beginning and no end, and life, too, lives through eternity.

D1/EVENT.BIN:489.en: And then gain new life... ...a new world of illusion begins...

D1/EVENT.BIN:49.en: But what would anyone build a giant dome like this for?

D1/EVENT.BIN:490.en:
You're saying all of this is illusion? ...A meaningless world?
That all the battles we fought were illusions too?

D1/EVENT.BIN:491.en:
Yes! A world of illusion born of the real world and the flesh.
Human life is led astray by that illusion, imprisoned in it, wounding even its own flesh.
The demons you fought were born within that illusion, and built their world within that illusion.

D1/EVENT.BIN:492.en:
Asuka, your battle within the illusion is over.
The illusion that imprisoned and wounded you has vanished through the strength of your will.

D1/EVENT.BIN:493.en:
Your life will dwell in flesh once more
and build a new world of illusion.

D1/EVENT.BIN:495.en:
Whatever kind of world it may be,
it will still have been born of life's shining power.....
And that... ...is the world you will live in.

D1/EVENT.BIN:497.en:
Welcome to my temple......
...So... ...you have come after all...

D1/EVENT.BIN:5.en:
By the way, the Ueno museum opens a ruins exhibition next month.
I hear the crystal statue we digitized will be on display.

D1/EVENT.BIN:50.en:
Perhaps they were studying some truly vicious creature.
Either way, there's nothing we can do here. Come, let's go outside.

D1/EVENT.BIN:500.en: I don't really understand... ...what I'm here for...

D1/EVENT.BIN:501.en:
I understand.
You have returned, just as the Covenant sworn before time began decreed.

D1/EVENT.BIN:503.en:
It seems the time of your rebirth has not yet come...
But now that you have returned to the Demon World, it cannot be far off.
.....Before your awakening, it would be well for you to join the battles waged here in the Demon World.

D1/EVENT.BIN:504.en: There are battlefields even in the Demon World...?

D1/EVENT.BIN:505.en:
Yes. The battles of lives reborn again and again until they descended to the Demon World,
striving for their final rebirth...

D1/EVENT.BIN:507.en:
Welcome home, my lord.
......At last, the time has come.
The time for you yourself to fulfill... ...the words you yourself swore...

D1/EVENT.BIN:509.en:
My lord and master, why do you hesitate?
Fulfill the words of the Covenant you yourself promised in ancient times.
Or will you break the Covenant and, as you are, do battle against your own legions?

D1/EVENT.BIN:510.en:
Now, the time for decision has come...
Bring an end to this aged world, and at the dawn of a new one,
bestow the words of a new Covenant.

D1/EVENT.BIN:511.en:
Be reborn as the Demon God?|Yes
No|All the companions who fought beside you have vanished.

D1/EVENT.BIN:514.en: Aeacus...... He who unravels the words of the Covenant.

D1/EVENT.BIN:515.en:
Guided One, remember the words of your own Covenant...
At the dawn of ancient time, you promised in your own words that you would return here.....

D1/EVENT.BIN:516.en:
......I remember......
When I created this world...
I scattered my own being throughout it, so that it would be reborn again and again...
...to prepare for the final battle... ...that would come once more...

D1/EVENT.BIN:517.en: And you sent me... ...here to the Demon World...

D1/EVENT.BIN:519.en:
...Leading new legions... ...It has been a long time, my lord...
Now, to the field of the final battle.

D1/EVENT.BIN:52.en:
Right here! Just took me a sec.
Come on, let's get this started.

D1/EVENT.BIN:520.en:
My Creator...... ...congratulations.
Now, create a new world, and tell me the words of the new Covenant.

D1/EVENT.BIN:521.en:
My lord, what do you grieve...?
Has something displeased you...??

D1/EVENT.BIN:523.en:
Rejoice in my victory!!
The old world has perished, and the ancient Covenant... ...is fulfilled!!

D1/EVENT.BIN:524.en:
At the dawn of a world woven anew from countless nights and days,
hear the words of my new Covenant!
Chosen ones who dwell in heaven and the netherworld, proud heroes entrusted with the earth, demons who rule the Demon World!
When you gather in this land once more across eternity, gather beneath me!
Then your lives shall find the light of glory in the new world that begins anew.

D1/EVENT.BIN:525.en:
Fulfill the words of the new Covenant.
Cross time, weave life... ...and on a new battlefield... ...seek the light of glory!

D1/EVENT.BIN:527.en:
I am Athena, queen of the Demon World.
Who touched my soul, betrayed in the final hour of my past life?

D1/EVENT.BIN:529.en: They say the demons are gathering north of Mt. Fuji.

D1/EVENT.BIN:53.en: You'll get used to it. Don't rush it, Keita!

D1/EVENT.BIN:530.en: Why would they gather somewhere with nobody around?

D1/EVENT.BIN:531.en:
To descend to the Demon World, apparently.
Someone... reborn as a witch... ugh... what's happening to me...

D1/EVENT.BIN:535.en:
Asuka, demons are heading for Tokyo from Mt. Fuji.
Let's go too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:537.en:
Kee-ho! It's me! Imp the evil spirit!
House calls for folks who skip the manual! Lucky you, bro!
Or are you a sis? Then you're extra welcome!
I'm on the player's side, so I'll teach you this and that!
Today: how to make a demon a "unit"!
A unit is a character you can give orders to on a stage.

D1/EVENT.BIN:538.en:
First, press Start on the world map, or pick "COMM" on the panel and press confirm.
The world map is this map screen, by the way.
A list of commands pops up!
Put the cursor on "DEVIL" at the top and press confirm.
Those are the commands for us demons. You'll use 'em a lot, so remember!

D1/EVENT.BIN:539.en: See, a bunch more popped out, right? Pick "UNIT" at the top and press confirm!

D1/EVENT.BIN:540.en:
The screen changes. Here you pick the demon to make a unit.
See "Loyal" on the far right? Can't see it? The far right one!
It shows how loyal us demons are to Asuka.
I'm at 80! Demons at 50 or more can become units.

D1/EVENT.BIN:541.en:
Pick a demon with loyalty 50 or more and the screen changes.
This is the nickname screen. You can name a demon that's becoming a unit.
But only 6 letters, max!
Once I'm named, I'm officially a unit!
That's all for units! Easy, right?

D1/EVENT.BIN:542.en:
Oh, and the game goes on if us demons die, but if a human ally or reinforcement dies,
it's game over, so watch out!
Joker can't die either! Kinda playing favorites, huh...
But we vanish when we die, so take good care of us!
Well, that's about all I can teach you.
See ya!

D1/EVENT.BIN:543.en:
Hi there! Have you got units figured out?
Wasn't Imp's explanation hard to follow?
This time I'll explain contracts nice and clearly!
To become a unit, a demon needs loyalty of 50 or more, right?
So demons with low loyalty need their loyalty raised.
To do that, they have to make a contract with a person called a conductor.

D1/EVENT.BIN:544.en: First, select "DEVIL" and lots of commands appear, right?

D1/EVENT.BIN:545.en: Pick "CONTRACT", second from the top, fourth from the bottom!

D1/EVENT.BIN:546.en:
The screen changed, right? Here you pick the demon to contract!
As you pick demons, a conductor's name shows at the bottom right.
The demon under the cursor can contract with the person named there.
If no name shows, that demon can't contract, or no conductor can take it.
If a mark shows, several conductors can take it.
Press right to switch conductors, and pick the one you want!

D1/EVENT.BIN:547.en:
Once the demon and conductor are set, choose the contract magic.
Contract magic is magic the contracted person can then use!

D1/EVENT.BIN:548.en: For example, Charlie normally can't use magic.

D1/EVENT.BIN:550.en:
Next, my status.
Let's zoom in on the magic!

D1/EVENT.BIN:551.en:
See, I have Dia and Zio!
If Charlie and I make a contract with Zio as the magic...

D1/EVENT.BIN:553.en:
See, Zio's under his magic now!
Charlie can use magic!
But! If the conductor's MP runs low, the magic won't work, so careful!
Then in battle, have the contracted person summon the demon or use the magic!
That raises the contracted demon's loyalty.
Fighting side by side helps you understand each other!

D1/EVENT.BIN:554.en:
Once loyalty hits 50, the demon can become a unit, so end the contract.
That's all for contracts!

D1/EVENT.BIN:555.en:
Now about Level Up and Rank Up.
At 100 EXP, you level up.
When a demon levels up you can't pick which stat rises,
but when a human levels up, you can!
You choose one of six stats.
I'll explain those too.

D1/EVENT.BIN:556.en:
First, VITALITY: stamina.
It lowers damage taken and affects how much MAX HP grows.
Raise it for people with low HP or who take lots of damage!

D1/EVENT.BIN:557.en:
Next, MAGIC: magical power.
It lowers damage from spells.
Raise it for people weak to magic, and relax!

D1/EVENT.BIN:558.en:
Then STRENGTH: muscle.
It raises damage from weapon attacks.
People who can't use magic need it, or they're useless!

D1/EVENT.BIN:559.en:
INTELLIGENCE: wisdom.
It raises damage from attack spells, so magic users should raise it!

D1/EVENT.BIN:560.en:
And AGILITY: speed.
Raise it if your attacks miss. Strength is no use if you can't hit!

D1/EVENT.BIN:561.en:
Last, LUCK.
It makes critical hits more likely, so raise it now and then!
That's the stats. Raise them to suit each person.
You may also learn magic when you level up!
So even a demon that seems useless might learn strong magic if you raise it.
Don't judge by looks! That's leveling up, I think.

D1/EVENT.BIN:562.en:
Now Rank Up! Same screen, only the title differs, so don't worry.
When Training (TRN) hits 100, you rank up!
Ranking up raises how much Magnetite you can carry and how far you can move.
Conductors can also contract more demons and summon in more places.
Demons sometimes get more Arcana uses!
Arcana is the same as "EXTRA" in the earlier games:
a special skill only demons can use!
It costs no MP, but its uses are limited!
Rank up and the uses keep growing!
But uses gained by ranking up don't count on that stage!
They take effect from the next stage.
And as a bonus, I'll explain the game modes too!

D1/EVENT.BIN:563.en:
Ahem! Today I shall personally teach you Damage Control and Magic Resist.
Listen, and be grateful!
First, Damage Control. Behold the status screen!

D1/EVENT.BIN:564.en:
This is my status. Dashing, is it not!
Now, zoom in on Damage Control at the bottom right.

D1/EVENT.BIN:565.en:
It changes the damage taken from attacks.
The sword mark on the left is for slashing. Slashing weapons are swords, axes and guns.
It changes the damage you take from those.
The letter beside it shows how much.
Normal is "C". Strong is "A". Weak is "E".
Strong  S A B C D E  Weak
Remember: E is weakest, stronger toward A.
The spear mark in the middle is for piercing.
Piercing weapons are claws, spears, bows and javelins.
The staff mark on the right is for striking.
Striking weapons are staves, whips and throwing weapons.
Check it when damage seems bigger or smaller than you expected.

D1/EVENT.BIN:566.en:
Next, Magic Resist! It shows resistance to magic attacks.
It's under Damage Control, see?
The fire mark at top left is fire. It changes damage mainly from Agi spells.
The ice mark beside it is cold: Bufu spells.
Further right is lightning: Zio spells.
Bottom left is force: Zan spells.
Next to it is mind: spells like Panic and Sleep.
On the right is body: spells like Poison and Paralyze.
The letters mean the same as for Damage Control, so I won't repeat myself!

D1/EVENT.BIN:567.en:
But there is a special new one: "H".
It means magic of that type restores HP.
Use demons with it well, and who needs healing!
Let me show you some demons' Magic Resist.

D1/EVENT.BIN:568.en:
Here, this is the screen for choosing a target. See "HIT" at the bottom?
It shows how likely the attack is to hit.
Agility changes it, but it mostly depends on the weapon.
Piercing weapons hit more easily from below the enemy,
and less easily from above.
Striking weapons hit more easily from higher ground,
and less easily from below, naturally.
Slashing weapons hit more easily at the enemy's height,
and less easily from above or below.
That covers hex height and weapons.
Lastly, I shall teach you weapon range.

D1/EVENT.BIN:569.en:
There are two kinds of weapons: direct and indirect.
The six direct weapons are swords, axes, claws, spears, staves and whips.

D1/EVENT.BIN:57.en: It seems something terrible has begun.

D1/EVENT.BIN:570.en:
They can only attack adjacent units.
And not across a height difference of 2 or more.

D1/EVENT.BIN:571.en:
Next, indirect weapons: guns, bows, javelins and throwing weapons.
They can't hit adjacent hexes, but can hit units 2-3 hexes away,
and the target can't strike back.
But... but! They can't strike back at enemy attacks at all.
No one gets everything, as they say.
Ideally, hold the front with direct weapons and attack from behind with indirect ones.
That's weapon range. The rest is practice! Do your best.
That was long, but if you get lost, read the manual.
Keep it close at hand! That's the surest way. Now I'm going home.

D1/EVENT.BIN:572.en:
Next, a demon Bufu spells don't work on.
Agi or Zan spells should do some damage.
That's Magic Resist. I'm a fine teacher, am I not?
Right! As a bonus, I'll explain hex height and weapons too!

D1/EVENT.BIN:573.en: This demon is strong against Bufu, Zio, mind and body spells.

D1/EVENT.BIN:574.en: This one resists magic overall. Zan barely hurts it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:575.en:
This game has a Normal mode and a Hard mode.
First, the differences!
You get more money in Normal mode than in Hard mode!
Big spenders, pick Normal!

D1/EVENT.BIN:576.en:
Also, in Hard mode you can't save during a stage,
but in Normal mode you can!
You can save on the battle screen when your phase comes around.
It looks handy, but it can be a trap!

D1/EVENT.BIN:577.en:
Careful: if you save by mistake when you can't possibly win,
you'll have to start over from the beginning.
So you don't end up with only saves like that,
keep at least one save made on the world map!

D1/EVENT.BIN:578.en:
Look, press the X button on this screen to save.
But press A, B or C and you can't save, so careful!

D1/EVENT.BIN:579.en: This is a world map save! It shows the stage you cleared, see?

D1/EVENT.BIN:58.en: Anyway, let's look for the people we met in the virtual space.

D1/EVENT.BIN:580.en:
And this is a save inside a stage! It shows the map you're fighting on!
To tell them apart, check whether it says "Clear" or not!
Don't fill up with in-stage saves and get stuck!
Sometimes the fighting goes on after a stage clear without returning to the world map,
so save whenever you clear a stage!
If you lose without saving, you restart from your last save!
Keep this in mind and you'll surely reach the end! ...I think.
Good luck!

D1/EVENT.BIN:59.en: They said they were US soldiers, right?

D1/EVENT.BIN:6.en: Right. Maybe we should go see the real thing...

D1/EVENT.BIN:60.en: There are several bases around Tokyo, aren't there?

D1/EVENT.BIN:63.en:
I'm an assistant in the archaeology department.
The crystal statue shown at the Ueno museum was brought here from the Aztec ruins.

D1/EVENT.BIN:65.en: You know a man named Thompson, don't you?

D1/EVENT.BIN:66.en: He's a friend of Professor Ando in archaeology. I met him in the professor's office.

D1/EVENT.BIN:67.en:
We went to his laboratory.
Its terminal still had access data for a virtual space... and you were in that virtual space.

D1/EVENT.BIN:68.en: My little brother Satoshi was taken by demons at the Ueno museum.

D1/EVENT.BIN:69.en: And that man Thompson was there.

D1/EVENT.BIN:7.en:
August 2008
Tokyo National Museum - Aztec Ruins Exhibition
D1/EVENT.BIN:7.note: no pointer to this message (likely unused): caption 'August 2008 - Tokyo National Museum, Aztec Ruins Exhibition'

D1/EVENT.BIN:70.en:
I see... your brother...
All right! I really shouldn't be giving you this, but I can't stand that Thompson.
He left this disk here. Take it - it might be of some use.

D1/EVENT.BIN:72.en: By the way, who's that behind you?

D1/EVENT.BIN:73.en: He was lying collapsed in Thompson's lab.

D1/EVENT.BIN:74.en:
......Hmm...... No, I must be mistaken.
I'll do some digging of my own. I have a feeling we'll meet again.
Well then, take care.

D1/EVENT.BIN:77.en: ...I'm not sure... ...Let's try starting it up.

D1/EVENT.BIN:8.en:
Amazing... Big Brother...
It's strange to think a crystal statue like this was enshrined in ancient ruins.

D1/EVENT.BIN:80.en: Remix program data: continuing the regeneration process.

D1/EVENT.BIN:82.en: I am Angel... I will join you as your ally.

D1/EVENT.BIN:83.en:
Thompson was using this device to create demons.
No, to be precise, he was using demon data to synthesize other demons.

D1/EVENT.BIN:85.en:
That's right...
This device builds new data from the genetic information of living things.

D1/EVENT.BIN:86.en: Where would anyone get demon genetic data?

D1/EVENT.BIN:87.en:
How Thompson got it, I can't say.
But we can obtain demon genetic data ourselves...
For instance, from the demons inside our DIS...
However, if the genetic data is destroyed, the demon is destroyed with it.

D1/EVENT.BIN:88.en: We can synthesize new demons from the demons in there?

D1/EVENT.BIN:89.en: You mean Thompson's fighting demons just like us?

D1/EVENT.BIN:9.en: Satoshi, they say this statue has a crystal structure inside.

D1/EVENT.BIN:90.en:
That... I don't know yet.
We could test it with our own data, though...

D1/EVENT.BIN:91.en: Asuka, want to try using the demons in the DIS?

D1/EVENT.BIN:92.en: Oh, my baby... I'm so happy right now.

D1/EVENT.BIN:93.en:
The reason she's in such a good mood...
her best friend is having a baby next year...
and they say the baby shows up in her dreams and talks to her.

D1/EVENT.BIN:95.en: How do you know my name...?

D1/EVENT.BIN:96.en:
The papers are full of you.
As the leaders of an outlaw gang commanding an army of demons...

D1/EVENT.BIN:99.en:
According to the press,
the demons attack people on your orders.
It seems the big lie still works today.
It's a technique perfected long ago by a group called the Nazis.

D1/MSG01.BIN:0.en:
Humans, blind to the ages, wasting soul and life!
Hear the victory cry of my legions!

D1/MSG01.BIN:12.en:
This stuff looks usable!
Keita equipped the Rusty Axe! Equipped the Leather Armor!

D1/MSG01.BIN:13.en: Sakurako equipped the Attack Knife! Equipped the Indio Dress!

D1/MSG01.BIN:16.en:
Yikes! I hate dogs.
Get it away from me, kee-ho!

D1/MSG01.BIN:19.en: Satoshi... Where did you take Satoshi!

D1/MSG01.BIN:20.en: Asuka, calm down! Keep this up and you'll get yourself killed!

D1/MSG01.BIN:21.en: Easy, Asuka! Hear him out first. There's time!

D1/MSG01.BIN:22.en: So, what did you come back for?

D1/MSG01.BIN:24.en:
Then do you know where Satoshi was taken?
That Moloch took him!

D1/MSG01.BIN:25.en: If you don't know, then you're no use to us.

D1/MSG01.BIN:27.en: A unit? What are you talking about! Say it so we can understand!

D1/MSG01.BIN:28.en: Keita, don't get so worked up over a kid!

D1/MSG01.BIN:29.en: I'm just a grunt, I don't know! Ch-choking...

D1/MSG01.BIN:30.en:
I don't care!
This thing is one of the ones who took Satoshi!

D1/MSG01.BIN:33.en:
Don't thank us yet.
Depending on your answers, you might not walk away in one piece!

D1/MSG01.BIN:35.en: I didn't come back! I ran away!

D1/MSG01.BIN:36.en:
I'm just a grunt, so Moloch works me to the bone!
I got sick of it and ran away.

D1/MSG01.BIN:38.en: You met him, didn't you? Kinda looks like a bull!

D1/MSG01.BIN:39.en: Moloch's got lots of hideouts. I dunno...

D1/MSG01.BIN:4.en:
You mean this youth with the feeble soul!?
I shall keep him a while, as proof of my victory...

D1/MSG01.BIN:41.en:
I-I'll join you guys as your demon!
Then I can get back at Moloch too! H-how 'bout it?

D1/MSG01.BIN:42.en:
After all this commotion, if we walk around with a demon,
we'll get arrested!

D1/MSG01.BIN:43.en:
That's no problem!
With that gadget you've got, bro, you can keep me tucked away.

D1/MSG01.BIN:45.en: With that, you can make me a unit!

D1/MSG01.BIN:46.en: Even if I explained, you wouldn't get it, bro!

D1/MSG01.BIN:48.en:
Sis is way easier to talk to!
Anyway, to stay in this world, I have to become a unit!
And to make me a unit and send me out, you need Magnetite!
Just think of it as my salary, okay?
So from today on, I'm on your side, sis!
I'm Imp the evil spirit! Don't pick on me!

D1/MSG01.BIN:51.en: Asuka equipped the Ancient Sword! Equipped the Replica Suit!

D1/MSG01.BIN:52.en: Sakurako obtained the Attack Knife! Obtained the Indio Dress!
D1/MSG01.BIN:52.note: same scene as block 13 but 'obtained' instead of 'equipped'

D1/MSG01.BIN:54.en: Asuka, let's fight! We have to save Satoshi!

D1/MSG01.BIN:57.en: Joker was fitted with a Breastplate!

D1/MSG01.BIN:8.en:
Found something weird lying here. Might come in handy...
Obtained the DIS (Devil Inject Shield)!

D1/MSG01.BIN:9.en:
Standing around won't tell us where Satoshi is.
Let's wait at home...

D1/MSG02.BIN:0.en: It's them - the demons that showed up at the museum.

D1/MSG02.BIN:1.en:
Did you kids see the news and come too?
Or are you after the treasure the demons brought?

D1/MSG02.BIN:11.en:
He says he's British, and his name is Charlie Watts.
He studies ancient European civilizations at the Royal Academy of Sciences.
He heard on the news that demons from Celtic and Druid myth had appeared, so he came.

D1/MSG02.BIN:12.en:
Your little brother... demons took him away.
I, perhaps... can help you.

D1/MSG02.BIN:13.en: He says he wants to come with us.

D1/MSG02.BIN:14.en: Everyone... pleased to meet you. I am in your care.

D1/MSG02.BIN:15.en: By the way, Charlie, what an unusual accessory you have.

D1/MSG02.BIN:16.en:
This?
We Druids call it... "conductor item."

D1/MSG02.BIN:18.en: Conductor. Like one who leads... an orchestra.

D1/MSG02.BIN:19.en:
You mean the guy waving a little stick at the orchestra?
So in your country, they wave that cross around instead of a stick?

D1/MSG02.BIN:2.en:
We don't know anyone named Thompson.
We picked this up at the Ueno museum...

D1/MSG02.BIN:20.en:
Of course, not so!
I give you... a small lecture about conductors!

D1/MSG02.BIN:21.en:
The Druids have a teaching of rebirth.
People die, and are born again.
In this, there is special case: dead gods are reborn as humans.
What we call conductors are these humans, reborn gods.
Things they used when they were gods, we call conductor items.

D1/MSG02.BIN:22.en:
When conductor wears conductor item, the power awakens.
Then, he can make contract with demons who belong to him.
I myself, can contract with Fairy, Jirae, and Genma.
Now, I introduce! The Pixie we made our ally just now!

D1/MSG02.BIN:23.en: Wh-whoa... So can I make contracts with demons too!?

D1/MSG02.BIN:24.en:
Sadly, from you I feel no power.
If anyone... Asuka! From you I feel power. Faint, but there.

D1/MSG02.BIN:25.en: I have that kind of power...?

D1/MSG02.BIN:26.en:
Your brother taken by demons...
Thompson's actions... I do not think it is chance.
I think someone intends this.

D1/MSG02.BIN:28.en: Hi there! Nice to meet you!

D1/MSG02.BIN:29.en:
We have not made contract with her yet!
Now I make contract with her and raise her loyalty. Then...
I can make her fine lady! No - a fine unit.

D1/MSG02.BIN:3.en:
Thompson's lab is in Neo Coast City in Ariake.
...Well, never mind...
Anyway, you'd better keep your distance!

D1/MSG02.BIN:31.en: Hee hee! You're cute too, sis!

D1/MSG02.BIN:35.en:
Spheres that show up with the demons...
You're after the treasure inside them too, aren't you?
It's dangerous, so keep away...?????
Hey, isn't that a DIS you've got?
Then are you friends of Thompson's too?

D1/MSG02.BIN:37.en: He says he'll help us beat the demons!

D1/MSG02.BIN:38.en:
Thanks! All right, let's scatter them in one go!
Charlie joined the party!

D1/MSG02.BIN:4.en: Satoshi! Is that you? Are you all right...?

D1/MSG02.BIN:5.en: Asuka, let's hurry! We have to get Satoshi back.

D1/MSG02.BIN:6.en: Asuka! That's not Satoshi. He doesn't even look Japanese!

D1/MSG02.BIN:7.en:
My name is Charlie Watts.
I came here because devils came up in this park.

D1/MSG02.BIN:8.en: Tch, English, huh... Sakurako... you handle this...

D1/MSG02.BIN:9.en:
Devils!?
You came here to see the devils, didn't you?
What do you know about the devils?
They kidnapped his brother.

D1/MSG03.BIN:0.en:
Give Lilim back! What do you mean to do with her?
Do you think mere humans can master that beautiful body and proud heart...?
Could it be! You haven't sealed Lilim into an item, have you!

D1/MSG03.BIN:1.en:
This demon Lilim has nothing to do with us.
What matters is a demon took my brother. One of your kind, calling himself Moloch.
Tell me about him.

D1/MSG03.BIN:2.en:
What do I know of other demons or other legions!
Just as you want your brother back, I want Lilim back.
It galls me, but it seems I have lost this battle.
But I cannot be reborn yet.
Not until I have Lilim back in this world...
Azazel joined your demons!

D1/MSG03.BIN:4.en:
Foolish humans!
How dare you snare my Lilim and carry her off!

D1/MSG03.BIN:5.en:
...What are you talking about?
We don't know anything about some demon named Lilim!

D1/MSG03.BIN:6.en:
Don't play dumb!!
How will you quell my wrath, blazing like the fires of hell, and atone for your sin?
Return Lilim to me this instant! Or I'll tear you apart and devour you!
Just like the humans who were in this building!

D1/MSG03.BIN:7.en: Sealed? What do you mean, sealed?

D1/MSG03.BIN:8.en:
Still playing dumb! I know...
you seal us demons into weapons and armor to prepare for battle!

D1/MSG04.BIN:0.en:
Oho! More wanderers have strayed in.
Very well... Now, demons of my legion, devour these human souls to your hearts' content!

D1/MSG04.BIN:1.en:
So you found this virtual space too.
I don't know your story, but help us take them down.

D1/MSG04.BIN:10.en: Do you know the demons have begun invading the real world?

D1/MSG04.BIN:11.en: No, we were in Neo Coast City.

D1/MSG04.BIN:12.en:
Demons have started attacking all over Japan...
I hear even the Self-Defense Forces have been sent in.

D1/MSG04.BIN:13.en:
We're US soldiers stationed in Japan.
Our base has been attacked by demons too.
We chased demons that appeared in a virtual space the US military runs,
and followed them into this space.

D1/MSG04.BIN:15.en:
......We're out of time!
Once you're back in the real world, contact us! The place is...

D1/MSG04.BIN:2.en:
I'm Maria. US Navy, Marine Corps.
......Let's talk later. First, let's take out these demons.

D1/MSG04.BIN:3.en:
So this is what was going on...
Oh!? Aren't you the people who were at Yoyogi Park?

D1/MSG04.BIN:4.en: Never mind us. Who are you?!

D1/MSG04.BIN:5.en:
I'm Sawaki. I'm an archaeology assistant at the university.
Doesn't look like we have time to sit and chat here.
Once you get out of here, come to T University in Hongo. Well then......

D1/MSG04.BIN:8.en: Where are you kids accessing the network from?

D1/MSG04.BIN:9.en: What about you? Why are you here?

D1/MSG05.BIN:0.en:
Heh heh heh... Hey, punks! What're you actin' tough for?
Thanks to the demons, the nosy cops and lame old geezers all ran off. This place is our paradise now!
The toll's a little steep!

D1/MSG05.BIN:1.en:
It seems demons have appeared here too.
The network company the Ariake lab was accessing should be just ahead.
And we must help that girl over there.
Do you remember the conductor power I told you about when we first met?
She seems to carry the same power inside her.

D1/MSG05.BIN:10.en:
I might... Curse your fate...
Moloch is a demon who demands sacrifice, but I have no time to waste on you now.
Ask a demon about demons.

D1/MSG05.BIN:13.en:
Geez, the places demons show up just keep multiplying.
What the hell is going on?

D1/MSG05.BIN:15.en:
Asuka, the network company's headquarters is right there.
If we access its host computer, we should learn what Thompson was doing.

D1/MSG05.BIN:16.en:
More and more nasty-looking types keep showing up.
What the hell is going on?

D1/MSG05.BIN:17.en:
What are you talking about!
Why don't YOU get out of the way!

D1/MSG05.BIN:18.en:
Well, if it ain't Reika the tarot reader.
Word is, for all that cute face, you're a real wildcat.
Quit stickin' your nose in and go home before you get hurt.

D1/MSG05.BIN:19.en: That's the man who was talking to Satoshi at the museum!

D1/MSG05.BIN:2.en:
Asuka's kinda cool!
Maybe I'll tag along for a while...
Reika joined the party!

D1/MSG05.BIN:20.en:
Yes... Thompson.
I thought that if I followed Moloch, I would find you.

D1/MSG05.BIN:21.en:
What do you want now?
I have no time to bother with you...

D1/MSG05.BIN:23.en:
Moloch took my brother.
Tell me everything you know about Moloch.

D1/MSG05.BIN:24.en: I see. So you're the brother of the boy Moloch took...

D1/MSG05.BIN:25.en: Do you know where my brother is?

D1/MSG05.BIN:26.en:
I might... Moloch is, even among demonkind,
a fanatic who demands sacrifice. You may be too late, even if you chase him.

D1/MSG05.BIN:28.en:
If you still want to know where your brother is, ask a demon.
When it comes to demons, it's best to ask a demon.

D1/MSG05.BIN:29.note: text is just 'ま' - looks like an unused fragment

D1/MSG05.BIN:5.en:
Who are you people? ...Hm?
Is that... Charlie?

D1/MSG05.BIN:6.en: You were talking to my brother Satoshi at the Ueno museum.

D1/MSG05.BIN:7.en:
We went to your lab in Neo Coast City too.
What was that system built for?

D1/MSG05.BIN:8.en:
I see. So the one Moloch took was your brother.
Just what a fanatical demon would do...

D1/MSG05.BIN:9.note: variant scene; same meaning as line 276

D1/MSG06.BIN:0.en: There! That's the guy we met in the virtual space!

D1/MSG06.BIN:1.en:
Hey, it's you. I'm Willie Montezuma, US Army Green Berets.
Glad you came, you're a big help.
We'll talk after we deal with the demons...
Willie joined the party!

D1/MSG06.BIN:2.en:
Hey, it's you guys. I'm Maria from the Marines...
Maria Warwick. Anyway, let's take care of these guys first...
Maria joined the party!

D1/MSG06.BIN:3.en: Abaddon! Where are you going, abandoning us?

D1/MSG06.BIN:4.en:
Abandoning? Yurlungur, you are merely the first form in the Dragon King line of rebirth.
Stop whining and fight! We only follow what Queen Athena and Lord Aeacus decided between them.

D1/MSG06.BIN:5.en: All right, let's take a breather in this base's warehouse.

D1/MSG06.BIN:7.en:
Hey, it's you. I'm Willie Montezuma, US Army Green Berets.
Glad you came, you're a big help!
Willie joined the party!
D1/MSG06.BIN:7.note: variant of block 1 - second sentence differs: 'glad you came, you helped us'

D1/MSG06.BIN:8.en:
Hey, it's you guys. I'm Maria from the Marines...
Maria Warwick. Thanks to you, we wrapped this up fast.
Maria joined the party!

D1/MSG07.BIN:0.en:
O Lord, guide these evil spirits gathered in our church.
Solomon joined the party!

D1/MSG07.BIN:1.en:
Solomon, you're enjoying this, aren't you!?
Maria joined the party!

D1/MSG07.BIN:2.en: Asuka, being around the Father makes me feel kinda happy!

D1/MSG07.BIN:3.en:
It seems to be over.
Now, everyone, let us return to the church. It's time for tea...

D1/MSG08.BIN:10.en:
What're you talkin' about! Who do you think raised you that big?
I'm the one who taught you how to fight, ain't I! Don't you sass me!

D1/MSG08.BIN:12.en:
Boys! Sorry, but I'm jumpin' in.
I'm Tokyo born and bred! I love fires and fights more than food.
Huh? Feel like I've met you somewhere... Ah, whatever! C'mon, boys!
Let's get this party started! Here goes, you blockheaded numbskulls!

D1/MSG08.BIN:14.en: Moloch! If your business is done, begone!

D1/MSG08.BIN:15.en:
No need to tell me. I shall vanish quietly.
But don't forget. That One is watching this battle!
Should you lose... you understand? I need not say more.

D1/MSG08.BIN:17.en: I, too, pray for your victory. Hahaha...

D1/MSG08.BIN:18.en:
Damn you, Moloch... Don't think things will always go your way!
Once I've finished these humans, I'll settle things with you!

D1/MSG08.BIN:2.en:
Asuka, you look pale... Heh... Fear not!
Alas, your brother is not dead. He has gone to Caina!
To the netherworld made by Cain, who slew his own brother...

D1/MSG08.BIN:3.en:
Hey! Let me help too!
Those demon bastards trashed my network.
Pop! Don't you go buttin' into a kids' fight!

D1/MSG08.BIN:4.en:
You boys are tough! I like you!
When you get back to Tokyo, come by my place. I mean it! See ya!
Hey, we're goin' home!!

D1/MSG08.BIN:6.en:
Where are we supposed to go, anyway!
Taking off without even leaving an address!

D1/MSG08.BIN:7.en:
Asuka, look! It's Satoshi!!
Asuka: Satoshi! Hang on, I'm coming!
D1/MSG08.BIN:7.note: block contains two speakers (Sakurako, then Asuka with inline name)

D1/MSG09.BIN:0.en:
Asuka Miroku! You are surrounded.
The authorities have ordered us to take you into custody under the Subversive Activities Prevention Act.
Drop your weapons and surrender quietly.

D1/MSG09.BIN:1.en:
Asuka, this is bad! They're armed with HPM - high-power microwave weapons.
That's future tech not even we US Marines have been issued.

D1/MSG09.BIN:2.en:
Well, that settles it.
But someone's pulling the SDF's strings to attack us,
and handing the demons their best weapons on top of it.
Who the hell is behind this?

D1/MSG09.BIN:3.en:
Someone with enough power to move an SDF special forces unit.
That guy's selling out humanity and giving the demons future weapons.

D1/MSG09.BIN:4.en:
I'm Tokyo born and bred! Fires and fights, the bigger the better,
but anybody sellin' people out to demons, I ain't lettin' slide!

D1/MSG09.BIN:5.en:
Pops, acting tough won't help.
Let's go find your son instead!

D1/MSG09.BIN:6.en:
I've heard about it too.
Rumor is, their unit has soldiers with superhuman powers from cyborg surgery.

D1/MSG09.BIN:7.en:
Even so, we can't back down!
Besides, there's no guarantee they're really on humanity's side.

D1/MSG09.BIN:8.en: The only way to find out is to fight them...

D1/MSG09.BIN:9.en:
All right! Let's raise some hell!
Shopkeeper joined the party!

D1/MSG10.BIN:0.en: Now, Asuka! Fight the demons I have created.

D1/MSG10.BIN:1.en: Now, Asuka! Fight the demons I have created.

D1/MSG11.BIN:0.en:
Security control level 3.
Unauthorized life-form detected. Auxiliary program running.
Computer Voice: Intruders advancing through Block A-4, Corridor Alpha.
Computer Voice: Operation "Melting Thunder" initiated...
Intruders will be eliminated under Case D.
D1/MSG11.BIN:0.note: block has inline 'Computer voice' speaker labels between lines

D1/MSG11.BIN:1.en:
......That was close...
Sysop joined the party!

D1/MSG11.BIN:10.en:
You mean Shinjuku? That was the demons defending themselves against a human reaction.
An unfortunate incident, but through talks with our nation's leadership, who made contact with the demons, the misunderstanding has been cleared up.
As proof, the demons' destruction has died down. Despite that reconciliation,
your actions are stirring up the demons' hostility.

D1/MSG11.BIN:11.en:
Then where is Satoshi?
The demons are tormenting him, and he's crying for help!

D1/MSG11.BIN:12.en:
Even among demons, there are legions acting against society, like you.
Satoshi, was it? He was carried off by one of those factions.
We have no choice but to leave him to the demons.
If you act on your own, you violate the terms of our reconciliation.

D1/MSG11.BIN:13.en: Then you are telling us to stand by and do nothing?

D1/MSG11.BIN:14.en:
They have waited patiently for a long time to bring humanity immeasurable knowledge and blessings.
We cannot endanger our friendly relations with them because one individual has gone missing.
Satoshi's case has been left in the demons' hands.

D1/MSG11.BIN:15.en:
Who asked you to decide that? Satoshi is my brother!
Whatever you decided on your own has nothing to do with me!

D1/MSG11.BIN:16.en: That's unfortunate. Then I'll have to ask you to stay put right here.

D1/MSG11.BIN:2.en:
Asuka Miroku, I presume. The SDF special forces weren't worth much, it seems.
Or are the demons you keep that powerful?

D1/MSG11.BIN:3.en:
So you're the slimeball who teamed up with the demons and handed 'em weapons!
I ain't lettin' anybody who sells out his own kind get away with it!

D1/MSG11.BIN:4.en:
Sell out? You're the ones defying the state.
We carry out this project on orders from above.

D1/MSG11.BIN:5.en:
Above...? Then Japan, as a nation, has made a pact with the demons...?
Doing that would make an enemy of the whole world...

D1/MSG11.BIN:6.en:
From your country, with its Christian morality, I suppose it would seem so.
But as history makes clear, there were ages when the beings you call demons
were worshipped as gods. Your worldview is surely not the only one.

D1/MSG11.BIN:7.en: That is the very logic of the devil!

D1/MSG11.BIN:8.en:
What you call demons are the first intelligent life humans have ever met besides ourselves.
Since the late twentieth century, humanity has hoped such beings existed, even in outer space.
Since ages past, they have crossed time and space trying to make contact with us.
But humanity then could not understand them.
So they withdrew, and waited for us to evolve.

D1/MSG11.BIN:9.en: They're killing people and destroying cities.

D1/MSG12.BIN:0.en:
Blast it, to think you'd come this far!
I've studied demon genes and even found a way to synthesize them,
and I won't have dim-witted apes like you getting in my way!

D1/MSG12.BIN:2.en:
I have no time to play with you.
Go and be demon food!

D1/MSG13.BIN:0.en: Where am I? What am I doing?

D1/MSG13.BIN:1.en:
My lord, are you unharmed?
The enemy has reached even here, it seems. Fall back into that shrine!

D1/MSG13.BIN:10.en:
On the outskirts of Hiraizumi, by the banks of the Koromo River.
My lord, has battle after so long left you shaken?

D1/MSG13.BIN:11.en:
...With respect... I must refuse!
I, Musashibo, wish to fight to the last and die!
This final pleasure I cannot leave to you, my lord.

D1/MSG13.BIN:12.en:
......
Musashibo, I never once thought of you as my retainer.
You are my greatest friend.

D1/MSG13.BIN:13.en:
My lord, I, Musashibo, have no regrets.
Until we meet again in the next life...

D1/MSG13.BIN:2.en:
Lord Yoshitsune! Fall back, quickly!
We'll scatter Yoritomo's army for you...

D1/MSG13.BIN:3.en: My lord, until we meet again in the next life...
D1/MSG13.BIN:3.note: shorter variant of block 13 (only the 'see you in the next world' part)

D1/MSG13.BIN:4.en:
Musashibo! Enough...
We have both lived an interesting life. Let us die by each other's blades in this shrine, and make it our last journey...

D1/MSG13.BIN:5.en:
Musashibo...
Ugh...! My head feels like it's splitting!
D1/MSG13.BIN:5.note: loose: original is 'Musashibo... ugh! My head feels like it's splitting!'

D1/MSG13.BIN:7.en: Keita? What am I saying? Where am I?

D1/MSG13.BIN:8.en:
Musashibo will go with you. This way, my lord...
Kichiji! I leave the rest to you. Come, Lord Yoshitsune...
(Escape to the shrine within 8 turns!)

D1/MSG13.BIN:9.en: Yoshitsune? Minamoto no Yoshitsune? Musashibo! Where am I?

D1/MSG14.BIN:1.en:
Mighty warriors of my legion, destroy the humans and the traitor demons who fawn on them!
Spill their blood in sacrifice upon the frozen earth of Caina!

D1/MSG14.BIN:11.en: You come too, Joker... Come on, let's go...

D1/MSG14.BIN:13.en:
Yes. He's using a T University lab for a while, it seems.
Rumor has it a Remix Station's been set up there too.
Right now I'm investigating the demons appearing around west Tokyo.
There seems to be a lot going on among the demons, too...
I'll let you know soon. I'll head to T University as soon as I'm done here...

D1/MSG14.BIN:15.en: Muhammad... Has your memory come back?

D1/MSG14.BIN:2.en: Moloch!! You, I will never forgive!!

D1/MSG14.BIN:20.en: Joker, you came. Good boy. Do you remember me?

D1/MSG14.BIN:23.en: ......You're late, Big Brother. Why didn't you come save me sooner...

D1/MSG14.BIN:25.en:
...It's too late... Moloch here has offered up my soul,
for the great being that is to come...
What you see now is just an empty shell without a soul...

D1/MSG14.BIN:26.en:
Come back, Satoshi! I'll take care of everything else.
If you've lost your soul, we'll just get it back.
Don't give up...

D1/MSG14.BIN:30.en: I go with Asuka. I worry for Asuka...

D1/MSG14.BIN:31.en:
...Yes, that's a good idea.
Right now, Asuka may need your strength.

D1/MSG14.BIN:33.en:
No, you've helped me a great deal.
I'm the one who should thank you.
Well then, Asuka. I'll come again when I find something!

D1/MSG14.BIN:36.en:
Asuka, no need for thanks. You helped me.
So now, I help you. Come, let us go!
Muhammad joined the party!

D1/MSG14.BIN:4.en: Moloch! Where did you take Satoshi?

D1/MSG14.BIN:5.en:
It seems you did not hear Satoshi's words?
Satoshi entrusted his soul to my hands. Now he stands with us demons of his own will.
Asuka! You too shall serve my legion!

D1/MSG14.BIN:6.en:
However lightly you demons treat human souls,
however you wound and break them, humans have the power to heal their souls and make them whole!
Not me, not my friends here, and not Satoshi - none of us are yours to play with!!

D1/MSG14.BIN:7.en:
What a stubborn soul! For a human of this age...
Very well. If you insist, see it with your own eyes and body.
See how meaningless a thing humans are.
And taste the true agony of hell!

D1/MSG14.BIN:8.en: Asuka, Thompson has shown up at T University.

D1/MSG15.BIN:0.en: What's the matter, little girl? Looking for something?

D1/MSG15.BIN:1.en:
You're so lame...
