Why do you always pick the hard way? You really are idiots.
I just can't believe you're the same species as elites like us.

D1/MSG15.BIN:13.en:
People aren't nearly as different in ability as you claim.
You're just using even the demons
to feed your own hunger for power.

D1/MSG15.BIN:14.en:
Asuka, a scholar must turn a blind eye to some sacrifice for the advancement of learning.
In the end, that is what leads to human progress.

D1/MSG15.BIN:15.en:
Azazel, so besotted with a woman you've thrown away even your right to rebirth...
Heh... Though if it's Lilim, who could blame you...

D1/MSG15.BIN:18.en:
Reika left the party...
Azazel joined your demons!

D1/MSG15.BIN:19.en:
Awful lot of crows and stray cats around here.
Feels like they're watching us. I'm gonna go check it out.

D1/MSG15.BIN:2.en:
Asuka, will you stand in my way no matter what?
Why does a human with your abilities side with the inferior masses,
and refuse to understand our plan to preserve only superior genes?

D1/MSG15.BIN:21.en:
I'm looking for the archaeology lab where Professor Ando is.
Do you know where it is?

D1/MSG15.BIN:24.en: Aren't you cute... Like a little doll...

D1/MSG15.BIN:25.en: Don't treat me like a kid! Just answer me!

D1/MSG15.BIN:26.en:
There's no point talking any further, is there?
Perfect timing! You can be guinea pigs for our research.

D1/MSG15.BIN:27.en:
Hm... That's a fine idea. The new demon abilities perfected by the geniuses gathered at this university
are best tried out on dropouts like you, who developed nothing but their muscles.
Results against you would be persuasive to the government, too.

D1/MSG15.BIN:28.en:
You made me go this far.
You'll have to make suitable amends...

D1/MSG15.BIN:29.en: Sorry I'm late. I never imagined this would happen...

D1/MSG15.BIN:3.en:
Thompson! I've finally found you!
For toying with the great Lilim's body and doing such shameless things,
I'll pay you back in full!

D1/MSG15.BIN:30.en:
Asuka, let's search Professor Ando's lab.
Whatever the demons say, we should do everything we can as human beings.

D1/MSG15.BIN:37.en: A human body has its limits after all...

D1/MSG15.BIN:38.en: Then I'll be taking this girl!

D1/MSG15.BIN:40.en:
I am Aeshma.
This is the first time I've introduced myself like this, isn't it...

D1/MSG15.BIN:41.en: Thompson was a demon all along...

D1/MSG15.BIN:6.en:
Asuka, let's search Professor Ando's lab.
Whatever the demons say, we should do everything we can as human beings.

D1/MSG15.BIN:8.en: To slip up in a place like this...

D1/MSG16.BIN:0.en: Asuka, you came. Now fight the demons I have created.

D1/MSG16.BIN:1.en:
Was this... was this really right...?
I don't know.........
......

D1/MSG16.BIN:12.en:
...It seems you are not functioning properly.
Then how about this?

D1/MSG16.BIN:13.en:
I-I am...
I AM XP-08. PLEASE INPUT COMMAND.

D1/MSG16.BIN:14.en:
Then I command you.
Dispose of the humans there. Understood?

D1/MSG16.BIN:16.en: A-Asuka and the others... are friends... I do not want... to fight...

D1/MSG16.BIN:17.en:
How stubborn.
Feelings are a function a clockwork doll does not need.

D1/MSG16.BIN:23.en:
A clockwork doll cannot win after all...
Very well. I shall face you myself.

D1/MSG16.BIN:24.en:
In the end, you too are only foolish humans.
Very well. I shall fight you with all my strength.
Now, XP-08! Throw off the rule of foolish humans!

D1/MSG16.BIN:26.en:
XP-08... no, Muhammad!
You betrayed us and sided with the humans. Now pay the price!

D1/MSG16.BIN:3.en: Asuka, so you choose to fight?

D1/MSG16.BIN:4.en:
I want to save Satoshi! That's all!
If you stand in my way, I'll defeat you, whoever you are!

D1/MSG16.BIN:5.en:
Asuka, you too are a selfish human...
Do you never think of the sacrifices made while you tried to save your brother?

D1/MSG17.BIN:1.en: So they have joined hands with the foreigners after all!

D1/MSG17.BIN:12.en: The foreigners seem to have pulled back to the village.

D1/MSG17.BIN:13.en:
Hmm...
I never imagined they'd keep up the sacrificial rites even if it meant joining hands with foreigners.
What was the priest trying to do?

D1/MSG17.BIN:15.en:
No, nothing. Just my imagination.
More importantly, the foreigners will be back with an army. We must hurry home!

D1/MSG17.BIN:18.en:
Could that have been...?
I see! What the priest was trying to do was...

D1/MSG17.BIN:19.en:
The time is at hand!
Tezcatlipoca! Receive the blood of the sacrifice, and fulfill the words of the Covenant!

D1/MSG17.BIN:2.en: So you've come, fools! Soldiers from abroad, go!

D1/MSG17.BIN:21.en:
Now every condition is met! The Demon God shall rise again!
And it shall destroy all that is old, and create the new world I desire! Bwahahaha!!

D1/MSG17.BIN:6.en:
So this is the end...
Tezcatlipoca! Receive my blood, and fulfill the words of the Covenant!

D1/MSG17.BIN:9.en:
Hurry! We're out of time!
(Defeat the priest within 8 turns!)

D1/MSG18.BIN:3.en:
No good.
At this rate we can't get to Antenora. We have to do something about Saturday...

D1/MSG18.BIN:4.en:
It's another virtual space, created when the interference twisted the phase!
Anything could happen, so be careful...

D1/MSG19.BIN:10.en: But we can't get into Antenora.

D1/MSG19.BIN:11.en:
Heh. Until just now, I was spying on Moloch's movements.
When he spotted me and I fled, I fixed the phase shift in the network city
and came to this space.

D1/MSG19.BIN:13.en:
That's right.
I've told you as much as a rescue is worth, haven't I? I'll be taking my leave!

D1/MSG19.BIN:14.en:
Moloch may escape.
Let's head to Antenora at once!

D1/MSG19.BIN:17.en:
It seems that demon has been cornered.
If we save it here and get some information, all the better...

D1/MSG19.BIN:18.en: Maybe we should help that demon.

D1/MSG19.BIN:2.en: To think I'd be rescued by a mere human. How amusing.

D1/MSG19.BIN:3.en: Isn't that the demon that ran off in Kichijoji?

D1/MSG19.BIN:4.en:
Sawaki mentioned it. The demons have two factions.
From the look of that demon, the demons around it have it cornered.
Let's help it. We might learn something about Satoshi.

D1/MSG19.BIN:6.en: Do you know a human named Satoshi?

D1/MSG19.BIN:7.en: ...The human Moloch carried off, I take it?

D1/MSG19.BIN:8.en:
That's right. That human!
Anything at all. Tell me!

D1/MSG19.BIN:9.en:
Rather than ask me, ask Moloch himself.
Moloch is in the network city Antenora.

D1/MSG23.BIN:0.en: Curse you, Moloch! You've thought of everything.

D1/MSG23.BIN:11.en:
Anyway, I'll look into it in detail!
And I forgot to mention - you'd better stay away from Hachioji.
From what I've gathered, most of the demons seem to be coming from the Hachioji side.

D1/MSG23.BIN:14.en:
What shall we do now?
That demon that fled earlier bothers me.
Not much time has passed, so it may be around Shinjuku or Ikebukuro...

D1/MSG23.BIN:16.en:
Anyway, standing here won't get us anywhere.
Well, let's think it over as we walk.

D1/MSG23.BIN:2.en: No choice. Best to withdraw for now!

D1/MSG23.BIN:3.en: It seems that's taken care of.

D1/MSG23.BIN:4.en:
It seems the demons are fighting each other?
Let's not rush in. We'll watch for now.

D1/MSG23.BIN:7.en:
Yeah, I picked up a bit of information.
It seems the demons have two factions.
One is the side that took Satoshi. We still don't know much about the other.

D1/MSG23.BIN:8.en:
Seems that way.
The demons were fighting each other here just now.

D1/MSG23.BIN:9.en:
I see...
If we learn more, we might be able to use that to our advantage.

D1/MSG44.BIN:0.en: Now, Asuka! Fight the demons I have created.

D1/MSG45.BIN:0.en: Now, Asuka! Fight the demons I have created.

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:1.en:
Not yet!
I can't die here!

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:10.en:
No dyin' in bed for me!
A Tokyo boy's lot...

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:12.en:
How unlike me...
Losing to a mere demon!

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:13.en:
What the heck is this!
Why am I always, always so unlucky?

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:16.en: I pushed a bit too hard...

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:19.en:
My lord, until we meet
in the next life...

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:20.en:
Gods of the Aztecs!
Protect your people!

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:4.en: Zeus... to lose to you, of all..

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:5.en:
Back to the cycle of rebirth?
So be it!

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:6.en:
How unlike me.
It seems I was careless...

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:7.en:
My reading said today was bad!
My fortunes come true way too often...

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:8.en:
Nooooo!
Give me one more chance!

D2/DEADMSG.BIN:9.en:
This is as far as I go.
Sorry for the trouble, all.

D2/END.BIN:1.en: Huh, we won before I even noticed? Was that thanks to me?

D2/END.BIN:10.en:
.....!
Shiranui is gazing at you warmly.

D2/END.BIN:100.en: Well done. Our army won, as it should! I suppose that makes me the goddess of victory!

D2/END.BIN:101.en: A splendid victory. My cooperation was worthwhile.

D2/END.BIN:102.en: You only won because of me, Big Brother! Kidding! Just kidding!

D2/END.BIN:103.en: Whoever struggled, whoever shone, victory is for everyone to share! Let's all be happy together!

D2/END.BIN:104.en: I'll at least say hello. ...Good job. That good enough?

D2/END.BIN:105.en: Asuka, you served well. Your deeds will be told for generations.

D2/END.BIN:106.en: We won because the great will of the universe made it so. I really believe that.

D2/END.BIN:107.en: It's over... Total combustion. I'm burned out.

D2/END.BIN:108.en: We won thanks to plasma, right? They said so on TV! It explains everything!

D2/END.BIN:109.en: This is it! For this moment I endured the shame of being called a traitor! I was not wrong!

D2/END.BIN:11.en: When the fighting ends, what becomes of us demons? Will peace really come after this?

D2/END.BIN:110.en: In this world, effort doesn't guarantee success. But you never know until you try!

D2/END.BIN:111.en: You have achieved one great purpose... For now, simply rest.

D2/END.BIN:112.en: Had I known it would be this hard, I'd never have come along. But I don't regret it. If anything, I'm grateful.

D2/END.BIN:113.en: It was no easy battle, but I gained comrades to share joy and sorrow with. I'm grateful to you.

D2/END.BIN:114.en: Phew! I'm beat... This victory's thanks to me working like a horse! Hey, you listening?

D2/END.BIN:115.en: Ook ook! Can I do the victory monkey dance?

D2/END.BIN:116.en: Don't let your guard down just because the battle's over! The moment you think it's over is the most dangerous!

D2/END.BIN:117.en: You are a true warrior! I must learn from you.

D2/END.BIN:118.en: Fighting was how I blew off steam... What now? For starters, let me punch you!

D2/END.BIN:119.en: You did well. The others say all sorts of things, but they're all grateful to you.

D2/END.BIN:12.en: Me do good? Me not dead weight? That all me worry about...

D2/END.BIN:120.en: Bwehehe! You really went and did it! Must be 'cause I made such a good bad example, right?

D2/END.BIN:121.en: Victory feels great! Worth skipping my shift as gatekeeper of hell!

D2/END.BIN:122.en: For a mere human to go this far - astonishing! Well? Won't you serve under me? I'll let you do as you please.

D2/END.BIN:123.en: Being a snake, that was one hiss-terically heavy fight! What, lame? Me go home...

D2/END.BIN:124.en: You're really strong... C-can I call you big bro?

D2/END.BIN:125.en: You're really strong! You're kinda my type! *blush*

D2/END.BIN:126.en: I'm crazy about you! I can't live without you! I'm never letting go!

D2/END.BIN:127.en: Heh... My help was worthwhile, it seems. As thanks, I'll drink everyone's blood - just short of killing you.

D2/END.BIN:128.en: Zzz... I'm totally beat. Let me sleep in peace. Zzz...

D2/END.BIN:129.en: I never got my chance to shine... Feels like I did better as an enemy.

D2/END.BIN:13.en: Is that all? What a feeble lot. I haven't even gotten serious yet!

D2/END.BIN:130.en: I'm dead on my feet... You work your demons way too hard! Have a little consideration!

D2/END.BIN:131.en: You finally went and did it... You really have way too much free time... Hooray for the idle!

D2/END.BIN:132.en: In the end, a lot of lives were lost... Was there truly no way to avoid this...

D2/END.BIN:133.en: Me happy! W-we won, after all...

D2/END.BIN:134.en: Right now you're the star of your own life! You're the man!

D2/END.BIN:135.en: Going with you, Big Brother, makes me so proud right now! Call me again if anything happens!

D2/END.BIN:136.en: You must be tired. Rest now. At least until the next battle begins...

D2/END.BIN:137.en: We won... All thanks to me! Be grateful!

D2/END.BIN:14.en: Phew, done and done. From tomorrow, I'm sleeping ten hours a day, got it!

D2/END.BIN:15.en: Huh, it's over? Felt long but was short, felt short but was kinda long? What am I even saying?

D2/END.BIN:16.en: Well done, my loyal subjects. This victory is thanks to you! ...Hey, somebody call me out on that!

D2/END.BIN:17.en: Me in good mood! You in good mood? Anyway, good mood!

D2/END.BIN:18.en: Congratulations! You did it. This is what your hard work earned! Come on, chin up!

D2/END.BIN:19.en: You were always gazing at me so warmly... I did not mind it.

D2/END.BIN:2.en: Victory! Surely the power of the love between Lilim and me. With a little help from the other extras, of course. Wahaha!

D2/END.BIN:20.en: Hip, hip, hooray! Hip, hip, hooray! Congrats! ...Wait, is that really all we're doing?

D2/END.BIN:21.en: Born in the shadows, I never dreamed I would stand in the spotlight like this... I truly thank you.

D2/END.BIN:22.en: I haven't trashed nearly enough! More! Let me run wild some more!

D2/END.BIN:24.en: Human. Well done. Now world is saved. Thanks from heart.

D2/END.BIN:25.en: Battle like this... must never happen again...

D2/END.BIN:26.en: Nobody even asked you, and you sure went all out! I'll make sure your ??? gets told for ages to come!

D2/END.BIN:27.en: Honestly, I never thought you could do this much. Humans aren't so bad after all...

D2/END.BIN:28.en: I learned a lot this time. I'll put this power to use in the rebuilding!

D2/END.BIN:29.en: We won, but much blood was shed... We must build a better world, or we cannot face those who died.

D2/END.BIN:3.en: Victory! Surely the power of the love between Lilim and me. With a little help from the other extras, of course. Wahaha!

D2/END.BIN:30.en: ...Is it truly over...? To me, this feels like the start of a new battle.

D2/END.BIN:31.en: Asuka... I'm grateful you didn't choose the path of the Demon Lord. If... no, never mind. Anyway, I'm glad...

D2/END.BIN:32.en: You finally did it! I was rooting for you from early on, so as an angel, I'm very proud.

D2/END.BIN:33.en: You'll help rebuild the city too, won't you, Asuka? Then let me lend what little help I can.

D2/END.BIN:34.en: Congratulations. A peace that cannot last forever has been restored. How long it continues is up to you humans.

D2/END.BIN:35.en: We finally did it. I am truly blessed to have fought at your side.

D2/END.BIN:36.en: In this battle, who was really in the right...? That is my greatest question...

D2/END.BIN:37.en: Now that the demons have lost the Demon God Angra Mainyu, I fear they may act rashly...

D2/END.BIN:38.en: What? You thank me? Okay! Special, you get to worship me!

D2/END.BIN:39.en: Ho ho ho! I knew you'd pull it off, sonny! I knew it from the start, I did.

D2/END.BIN:4.en: Asuka looks pretty cool from here. Maybe I'll trade up from Azazel?

D2/END.BIN:40.en: Cock-a-doodle! You hero! You and me, friends! Me so happy!!

D2/END.BIN:41.en: Never mind the talk - for now, let us just celebrate this victory! Bwahahaha!

D2/END.BIN:42.en: It seems to be over... I did fine work too, didn't I? I'll take my thanks in something solid, someday!

D2/END.BIN:43.en: Humans are strong! They say the kanji for "person" is two people holding each other up. Guess it's true!

D2/END.BIN:44.en: Huh, we won... I was sure we'd lose, but all's well that ends well!

D2/END.BIN:45.en: ...Hic. Victory wine sure goes to your head fast... Asuka, you drinkin' too?

D2/END.BIN:46.en: Asuka, ride on my back! Victory lap!

D2/END.BIN:47.en: Now that we've won, it was strangely easy. A long, steep road makes a good memory, looking back...

D2/END.BIN:48.en: You win! Me win too! Everybody win!

D2/END.BIN:49.en: Sawaki... dead... Nothing to be done? Right... Must be right...

D2/END.BIN:5.en: At last... it is over... Let us hurry home... to Satoshi...

D2/END.BIN:50.en: What me do now? Run in thing called "horse race"? Make money?

D2/END.BIN:51.en: How was my fighting? Ho ho ho... I won't lose to you young folks yet!

D2/END.BIN:52.en: Promise one thing! Me hate fusion... Oh. No need for promise anymore...

D2/END.BIN:53.en: Asuka, me friend! So if trouble, call! Me fly to you!

D2/END.BIN:54.en: Tagging along with you gave me some good memories too. Thank you...

D2/END.BIN:55.en: Me think better of humans now! Some humans good. You very good!

D2/END.BIN:56.en: We won! Well? Wasn't I useful? Catnip for my reward, please!

D2/END.BIN:57.en: C-congratulations, human. Me praise you, but no come close!

D2/END.BIN:58.en: Human, no be arrogant! No forget us demons helped!

D2/END.BIN:59.en: You worked me to the bone, so you're coming shopping with me. Dresses, bags, high heels...

D2/END.BIN:6.en: At last... it is over... Let us hurry home... to Satoshi...

D2/END.BIN:60.en: Well? I've still got it, don't I? If you want, Asuka, I'll show you my secret moves. How about it?

D2/END.BIN:61.en: Oh ho. I like you! Won't you marry into my family? My daughters are all beauties...

D2/END.BIN:62.en: The night is young! Bring more sake! By the barrel, please!

D2/END.BIN:63.en: Well done... Your fighting was a sight to behold. I shall count on you if anything happens again.

D2/END.BIN:64.en: Wow, you're amazing, for all your looks! Amazing how? A lady could never say!

D2/END.BIN:65.en: Hee hee! Just as I thought... Why don't you come to my place? I'll teach you about grown-up women...

D2/END.BIN:66.en: Total victory! The MVP this time is me, right? Do I get a prize?

D2/END.BIN:67.en: Ohohoho! A victory for my beauty, I'd say. Well, you did quite well yourself.

D2/END.BIN:68.en: Thank you for all your work. More than winning, I'm happy you came back safe...

D2/END.BIN:69.en: You worked so hard... As a reward, you can rest your head on my lap. I know! Ear cleaning too, right?

D2/END.BIN:7.en: We finally did it. I am deeply, wildly moved.

D2/END.BIN:70.en: Like, I was just killing time, but somehow I got totally hooked. Kinda lucky, I guess?

D2/END.BIN:71.en: Oh, quit fussing! With me here, of course we won! Be a little more composed!

D2/END.BIN:72.en: Don't get too happy... Another battle will start soon enough... Hee hee...

D2/END.BIN:73.en: You don't need jewels anymore, right? Give them to me. Of course, I'd never be so crude as to ask for them free...

D2/END.BIN:74.en: We finally won... By my calculations we should have won much sooner. I wonder why?

D2/END.BIN:75.en: Ugh, you worked me so hard, I'm totally stressed out! Am I breaking out or anything?

D2/END.BIN:76.en: What should we demons do now...? Can we live alongside humans?

D2/END.BIN:77.en: As the sun rises again, the day will come when this city is rebuilt... Until then, I'll stay at your side.

D2/END.BIN:78.en: Me worry... Other humans, not you... will they try to harm us demons...

D2/END.BIN:79.en: Demons split into sides, fighting each other - let this be the last time... I don't want to fight either.

D2/END.BIN:8.en: It's over... And yet I'm uneasy... Did I really pull my weight? Nine diamonds' worth?

D2/END.BIN:80.en: We finally did it... I cannot say it well, but I feel good too.

D2/END.BIN:81.en: "Justice wins in the end," huh! But the winners always say they're justice, so it's kinda funny.

D2/END.BIN:82.en: What, no beer shower? I even rehearsed for it...

D2/END.BIN:83.en: You go through all this trouble. You idiot! But you cool! Me want to be idiot too...

D2/END.BIN:84.en: What? If you came to say hello, you could at least bring a box of sweets.

D2/END.BIN:85.en: Me trust you and become your demon! So whatever you choose, me accept!

D2/END.BIN:86.en: Me a chicken? Me not, right? Say me not!

D2/END.BIN:87.en: Me fight with life on line too! God or Demon Lord, no matter!

D2/END.BIN:88.en: Hanging around while you killed time, I ended up all the way here... Oh well...

D2/END.BIN:89.en: Me work hard! You let me nibble you as thanks!

D2/END.BIN:9.en: Me happy! You happy! Anyway, happy!

D2/END.BIN:90.en: Hey, keep the food coming! Put it all on Asuka's tab!

D2/END.BIN:91.en: I'll go to sleep thinking about tomorrow. I won't wake up to find it was all a dream, will I...

D2/END.BIN:92.en: In battles like this, unsung heroes like me matter most. You understand, surely?

D2/END.BIN:93.en: Asuka... This battle's made you grow a size or two bigger...

D2/END.BIN:94.en: Water that stops flowing grows stagnant. So too do people grow corrupt in peace. What of you?

D2/END.BIN:95.en: Still worried about Sawaki? That's that, and this is this! You did what you had to do!

D2/END.BIN:96.en: Big Brother, you're so cool! I like you even more now! I'm never leaving you!

D2/END.BIN:97.en: Hee-ho! I'm the best! Now if there's a feast, I'll be in heaven!

D2/END.BIN:98.en: Hey, brother! Not bad! That's my little bro! Huh? Wait, am I the little bro?

D2/END.BIN:99.en: I was a big help, wasn't I! Pick me for the next battle too!

D2/MSG20.BIN:0.en:
Is that Nimrod I see?
What do you mean by defying the command of our King?

D2/MSG20.BIN:1.en:
The power struggles among us demons are a bit complicated, you see.
Only Lord Aeacus grasps them in full.

D2/MSG20.BIN:2.en:
Have I been betrayed?
Am I to die?
Must I be reborn once more...?

D2/MSG20.BIN:4.en:
It is you who have betrayed Lord Aeacus
and acted as you please.
Moloch! By Lord Aeacus's command, we have come to grant you the chance to be reborn!

D2/MSG20.BIN:5.en:
Lord Aeacus...?? That cannot be!
He surely knows I am disposing of these humans...?

D2/MSG20.BIN:6.en:
Enough talk. Give your head to my hand!
Your part is finished!

D2/MSG20.BIN:7.en: I don't care about demons... ...What about Satoshi...

D2/MSG20.BIN:8.en:
Lord Aeacus knows the truth of that too...
Sir Asuka, make for Mt. Fuji. The only way to Lord Aeacus's temple in the Demon World is the road to Yomi that opens from Fuji.
I ought to go with you, but other matters call me. I can only pray you stay safe.
Farewell, Sir Asuka. Until we meet again...

D2/MSG21.BIN:0.en:
Demons here too...
Where the hell do these demons keep coming from?

D2/MSG21.BIN:1.en:
Didn't that demon Nimrod tell us?
To reach the Demon World, you take this road to Yomi at Fuji!

D2/MSG21.BIN:2.en:
Sawaki said the demons come from the Hachioji side too.
So the ones in central Tokyo came from the Demon World through Mt. Fuji?

D2/MSG21.BIN:3.en:
Indeed. From here on, the fighting will be fierce.
We must be ready for it.

D2/MSG22.BIN:0.en:
Help me... I'm not a witch...
Knight: Silence! The Church has passed its judgment...

D2/MSG22.BIN:10.en:
Ugh... no time!
(Move to a hex next to Joanna within 12 turns)

D2/MSG22.BIN:14.en:
I see...
Then I'll have you die all over again!

D2/MSG22.BIN:16.en:
Die for me!
If you die, everything will work out!

D2/MSG22.BIN:17.en:
Heh heh...
Now that woman will fall into the Demon World too.

D2/MSG22.BIN:19.en: What are you? How do you know my name?

D2/MSG22.BIN:21.en:
A mere human. Not worth remembering!
I'll kill you right now!

D2/MSG22.BIN:23.en:
What a simpleton!
While you were out cold, I killed that woman!

D2/MSG22.BIN:25.en:
That's right!
My orders were to kill her while making her taste despair!
So I took your form and killed her! Did I overdo the theatrics a little?

D2/MSG22.BIN:27.en:
Relax! I'll kill you and that man there together!
Wh-what's this?

D2/MSG22.BIN:28.en:
Ugh... not again!
My head feels like it's splitting!
Aaargh!

D2/MSG22.BIN:30.en: I don't know... When I came to, I was here.

D2/MSG22.BIN:31.en:
You too! Actually, the same goes for me.
Ugh... That's right! Joanna!

D2/MSG22.BIN:5.en:
Coming here with demons at your side - fitting company for a witch!
Now, ready the stake!

D2/MSG22.BIN:7.en: It's me... I was Sawaki, at T University...

D2/MSG22.BIN:9.en:
This seems to be what I was in a past life.
But why are you here? And looking just as you do in our own time?

D2/MSG26.BIN:0.en:
At this rate, we'll be stuck staring down the demons forever!
And the hour the door to the Demon World opens keeps getting closer...
Isn't there another way?

D2/MSG26.BIN:1.en:
You appear in my netherworld and meddle needlessly in my legion's law of rebirth.
To what end??

D2/MSG26.BIN:10.en:
Calm down, Pops.
You're such a klutz... But when did these stairs show up?

D2/MSG26.BIN:11.en:
Huff, huff... How should I know!!
It's this dang rock's fault. Stupid thing... Huh??? It's gone!?
Keita: Pops, that's it!!
Kick the rocks and stairs appear! I bet that's it...!

D2/MSG26.BIN:12.en:
To open the door to the Demon World and demand the meaning
of the Covenant Aeacus swore before time began...

D2/MSG26.BIN:13.en:
You would go to the Demon World?
A bold thought for a mere human...
Do you think a human can grasp the secret of rebirth that is hidden even from us!

D2/MSG26.BIN:14.en: Because of that Covenant, my brother is trying to become a demon king.

D2/MSG26.BIN:15.en:
I see... but I cannot let you open the door to the Demon World.
The future belongs to demons who fight through agony.
What could humans, souls lost in their comfortable world, understand!

D2/MSG26.BIN:16.en:
Humans have souls too.
Fighting can't be the only way to live in this world!!

D2/MSG26.BIN:17.en:
I see. For us demonkind, fighting is the only way to live in this world.
To be reborn again and again, fight on, and gain ever greater power...
that is what our lives were given for. Very well. If I stop you here...

D2/MSG26.BIN:2.en:
We're goin' down there? Looks dicey.
One wrong step and it's straight down to hell!

D2/MSG26.BIN:3.en: Pops! This is supposed to be hell already.

D2/MSG26.BIN:4.en:
Heh heh, I know, I know. When you get old...
your footing gets shaky.

D2/MSG26.BIN:5.en:
This is Yomotsu Hirasaka... To the bottom of this pit...
come down...

D2/MSG26.BIN:6.en:
The door to the Demon World opens when the moon is next full.
By then, you must defeat Susano-o, king of this netherworld, or you cannot go to the Demon World!

D2/MSG27.BIN:0.en: As ever, you cannot keep from playing with your tools, it seems.

D2/MSG27.BIN:1.en:
A messenger has come from Lord Zeus.
He bids you fight without holding back, my lord.

D2/MSG27.BIN:2.en:
Very well. I have no wish to be king of the netherworld,
but to lead the world to the promised land, it cannot be helped. Advance my army!!

D2/MSG29.BIN:0.en: This is the address left in Muhammad's data.

D2/MSG29.BIN:10.en:
For now, all we can do is beat the demons.
After that, we leave it to luck...

D2/MSG29.BIN:14.en: No good. How about over there?

D2/MSG29.BIN:15.en:
Nobody there, but jackpot!
I found the underground factory! There's stuff that looks like Muhammad's parts, so we can manage!
Now all we need is an engineer and a place with the right system to fix him...

D2/MSG29.BIN:16.en: For now, let's take those parts with us!

D2/MSG29.BIN:3.en: On paper, it's the Yagami Group chairman's villa.

D2/MSG29.BIN:4.en:
The Yagami Group?
You mean... one of Japan's biggest conglomerates?

D2/MSG29.BIN:5.en:
Yes...
But it's strange it turned up in Muhammad's data, isn't it?
So I hacked into the Yagami Group's data bank.

D2/MSG29.BIN:7.en:
It's an emergency, I had no choice!
And it turns out this is a secret Yagami Group factory!
They've been bringing in parts nobody could tell the purpose of.
My hunch says this is probably where Muhammad was built.

D2/MSG29.BIN:9.en:
Honestly, I don't know.
It doesn't seem to be in use anymore, and demons showed up here early on...

D2/MSG30.BIN:0.en:
Blast it, search faster!
If we don't get that baby, there'll be trouble!

D2/MSG30.BIN:1.en:
Something seems to be here.
Shall we split up and search?

D2/MSG30.BIN:10.en:
Everyone, come here!
I found the baby Aeshma was talking about!

D2/MSG30.BIN:3.en:
Oh, Asuka...
I let you live that time,
and you come waltzing in here...
Very well! I thought it too soon to defy Aeacus, but it seems my patience is at an end.
Asuka, I'll kill you! And then revive that man as a false Demon God.

D2/MSG30.BIN:5.en:
You don't need to know!
Don't worry, I'll send your brother after you.

D2/MSG30.BIN:6.en:
Heh, you're better than I thought!
As expected of... no, this will be fun. Asuka, we'll meet again!

D2/MSG30.BIN:8.en: In the end, Aeshma got away, but...

D2/MSG30.BIN:9.en: But didn't he say something about finding a baby?

D2/MSG31.BIN:0.en: Asuka, leave this to me. You go after Satoshi!

D2/MSG31.BIN:1.en:
Nimrod, what do you think you're doing!
If we're routed here, our side loses the rebirth in the virtual spaces!

D2/MSG31.BIN:10.en:
The network cities are collapsing now, Big Brother.
In the real world, my demon legions and I are in control.
The strength of humans with weakened souls is nothing but bugs...
No matter how hard you all try, it's no use...
Oh, I know, come to the training grounds at Mt. Fuji. I'll show you our power.

D2/MSG31.BIN:12.en: Why would Aeacus worry about me?

D2/MSG31.BIN:13.en:
That, I have not been told either.
I was only ordered to help you.
Now, hurry and get out of here, or the virtual space will begin to collapse.

D2/MSG31.BIN:14.en:
Sorry I worried everyone! I'm all better now!
Reika joined the party!

D2/MSG31.BIN:2.en:
Big Brother, judging by how you fight here,
you seem to know a little about rebirth yourself.

D2/MSG31.BIN:3.en:
I'm glad I made it in time...
Lord Aeacus was worried about you.

D2/MSG31.BIN:5.note: Zeus speaker with an empty quote - no text to translate (keep name only)

D2/MSG31.BIN:6.en: It seems I made it in time.

D2/MSG31.BIN:7.en:
Satoshi, one day you too will understand the meaning of the Covenant...
Virtual spaces are a shoddy contraption.

D2/MSG31.BIN:8.en:
Big Brother, huh...
Heh. Ever since we were kids, you'd always come spoil things whenever I was having fun.
Always wanting my toys right away...
But this time, I won't let you get in my way.

D2/MSG31.BIN:9.en: None of that matters! Satoshi! Come back to me!!

D2/MSG32.BIN:0.en:
Lord Satoshi is busy offering sacrifices, and sends his regrets.
In his place, I, Anat, goddess of bloodshed, shall be your opponent.
Asuka! Receive my legion's baptism!

D2/MSG32.BIN:1.en:
Asuka, we all talked it over - what we should do from here.
We know you mean to go to Tokyo to stop your brother.
And that you've kept quiet because it's hard to tell us.

D2/MSG32.BIN:2.en:
We were born in different places and times, and raised in different worlds.
But we have fought the demons side by side and come this far together.

D2/MSG32.BIN:3.en:
We all feel the same. In the end, we didn't even need to talk.
And we all decided... we'd never let you go alone...

D2/MSG32.BIN:4.en:
Let us go, Asuka! However strong an army the demons muster,
as long as we don't forget to stand together,
we will reach the sacrificial altar where Satoshi is.

D2/MSG32.BIN:5.en: Everyone's waiting! For you to give the word to move out!!

D2/MSG32.BIN:6.en:
...Thank you...
And please tell everyone how I feel.

D2/MSG37.BIN:0.en: What are you doing! Kill them! Kill them!!

D2/MSG37.BIN:1.en:
Don't let a single one escape.
Show them what happens to anyone who gets in my way!
Kill them all! Go!!

D2/MSG37.BIN:10.en: Or else? Or else what, Big Brother?

D2/MSG37.BIN:11.en: Will you stop! Or won't you?

D2/MSG37.BIN:12.en: Look! Say hello to Big Brother.

D2/MSG37.BIN:14.en:
The time of my rebirth has come... The words of the Covenant are fulfilled,
and only the final hour remains...

D2/MSG37.BIN:17.en:
Cerberus!
Now I can forgive you even less, Big Brother!

D2/MSG37.BIN:2.en:
Long time no see, Big Brother...
Doesn't it feel like an awfully long time?

D2/MSG37.BIN:21.en:
That's right! But his name now is Cerberus!
A demon beast loyal to the Demon God!

D2/MSG37.BIN:23.en: Satoshi! Do you really mean to become the Demon God...

D2/MSG37.BIN:3.en: ...So... you did it... Big... Bro... ther!

D2/MSG37.BIN:4.en: Satoshi, is there really no way left to save you?

D2/MSG37.BIN:6.en:
You've done some pretty cruel things too, Big Brother...
Abandoning your brother - don't you think you're a horrible person?

D2/MSG37.BIN:7.en: Satoshi, stop it! You've gone mad!

D2/MSG37.BIN:8.en:
...Mad, you say!?
You heard the words of the Covenant too, didn't you!
Eternal life gained through rebirth after rebirth. Life handed down through birth after birth since time began,
and the words of the Covenant fulfilled at its end - you heard about them, didn't you!?

D2/MSG37.BIN:9.en: Stop it now! Or else I'll......

D2/MSG38.BIN:0.en: Big Brother, how dare you show your face to me.

D2/MSG38.BIN:11.en:
Why am I losing!? Why? Whyyy!!
No! I don't want to die! I don't want to die!

D2/MSG38.BIN:12.en:
Maybe Satoshi couldn't fully become the Demon God.
He said all that, but deep down...

D2/MSG38.BIN:15.en: So... you... did... it... Big... Bro... ther!

D2/MSG38.BIN:17.en:
The time of my rebirth has come...
The words of the Covenant are fulfilled, and only the final hour remains...

D2/MSG38.BIN:3.en:
Don't you recognize me? Heh, I guess I can't blame you.
Well? I'm hideous, aren't I?

D2/MSG38.BIN:5.en:
But it's fine...
I've gained a power no one can beat!
No one will ever look down on me again. No one will laugh at me. No one will humiliate me...

D2/MSG38.BIN:7.en:
I don't want a lecture.
I'm going to create a new world now. A world with only what I want in it...
I wonder if you'll be in it, Big Brother? Heh heh...

D2/MSG38.BIN:8.en:
So there's no saving you anymore...
Then I'll take you down with my own hands! It's the least I can do for you!

D2/MSG38.BIN:9.en: Can you? We'll find out soon enough!

D2/MSG39.BIN:0.en:
So we meet as enemies...
Saving me that day was your bad luck! Now you die!

D2/MSG40.BIN:0.en: So you have come this far at last. Then there is nothing for it but to fight.

D2/MSG40.BIN:1.en:
So this is my end...
Asuka, do not be swayed by Aeacus's words.
Choose the path you yourself desire...

D2/MSG41.BIN:0.en:
You've finally come. I've been waiting!
Asuka, I'll kill you!
And then I'll create the new world I desire!

D2/MSG41.BIN:1.en:
You've finally come. I've been waiting!
Asuka, I'll kill you!
And then I'll create the new world I desire!
Kill every last human!
D2/MSG41.BIN:1.note: variant of block 0 with extra last line 'Kill all the humans!'

D2/MSG41.BIN:2.en:
Such power, though you've yet to awaken?
...My new world... m-my...

D2/MSG42.BIN:0.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:1.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:11.en:
My lord, what do you grieve?
Has something displeased you...??

D2/MSG42.BIN:12.en:
No, I do not grieve...
I cherish!

D2/MSG42.BIN:14.en: The old world has perished, and the ancient Covenant is fulfilled!!

D2/MSG42.BIN:15.en:
At the dawn of a world woven anew from countless nights and days, hear my new Covenant!
Chosen of heaven and the netherworld, proud heroes of the earth, sages of the Demon World!
When you gather here again across eternity, rally beneath my banner!
Then your lives shall find the light of glory in the new world.

D2/MSG42.BIN:16.en:
Fulfill the words of the new Covenant!
Cross time, weave life, and on a new battlefield, seek the light of glory!

D2/MSG42.BIN:17.en: Keita, Sakurako! Can you two fight?

D2/MSG42.BIN:2.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:21.en: So it came to this after all...

D2/MSG42.BIN:22.en:
Everyone dies someday.
But... I would have liked to choose a more satisfying death...

D2/MSG42.BIN:23.en:
Can't even see my own fate...
Fortune-telling's not much use, is it...

D2/MSG42.BIN:24.en:
Looks like this is it...
Reality is... cruel.

D2/MSG42.BIN:25.en:
Like hell! I ain't dyin' like this!!
I ain't... dy... in'...

D2/MSG42.BIN:26.en:
Damn it! Am I gonna die in a place like this!
Are you okay with this!? Answer me, Asuka!!

D2/MSG42.BIN:27.en: Asuka, is this the ending you wanted?

D2/MSG42.BIN:3.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:4.en:
My Creator... ...congratulations.
Now, create a new world, and tell us the words of the new Covenant.

D2/MSG42.BIN:6.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:7.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:8.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG42.BIN:9.note: speaker name with empty quote - no text

D2/MSG43.BIN:1.en:
Sawaki, why!
Why'd you have to go and become the Demon God!

D2/MSG43.BIN:2.en: I am the Demon God Angra Mainyu.

D2/MSG43.BIN:5.en:
No buts about it!
I can hear it! Sawaki's voice, sufferin'!!

D2/MSG51.BIN:0.en:
I am Ahura Mazda, destroyer of demons.
By destroying you, of the Demon God's blood, this world's peace will be assured.

D2/MSG51.BIN:1.en:
Satoshi's finally come back to us,
and I'm not dying in a place like this!

D2/MSG51.BIN:2.en:
Rest easy. Your brother too is of the Demon God's blood.
After I destroy you, I shall destroy him as well.

D2/MSG51.BIN:3.en:
Hmph...
Such power, though the Demon God has yet to awaken...
